en: She chose to study chemical engineering because she was fascinated by the process of turning raw materials into useful products.
cn: 她选择读化学工程，是因为她对把原材料变成有用产品的整个过程特别着迷。

t: n. 会计与统计
en: She majored in accounting and statistics, so she can spot a discrepancy in the numbers from a mile away.
cn: 她主修会计与统计，账目上一丁点儿出入她一眼就能看出来。

t: n. 工商管理
en: He has a degree in business administration but can't manage his own grocery budget.
cn: 他拿了个工商管理学位，结果连买菜钱都算不明白。

t: n. 外语
en: Learning a foreign language can be frustrating at first, but it opens up a whole new world.
cn: 刚学外语那会儿确实挺让人崩溃的，可一旦开了窍，感觉就像打开了新世界的大门。

t: n. 基督降临节；降临期
en: Before the advent of smartphones, we actually had to memorize phone numbers, can you imagine?
cn: 在智能手机出现之前，我们居然得背电话号码，你能想象吗？
tip: ad(去/向) + vent(来) → 来到面前 → 到来，出现
phr: with the advent of 随着……的到来
the Advent season 降临节期

t: phr. 有氧舞蹈
en: My mom goes to aerobics dancing every evening, jumping around to loud music to stay fit.
cn: 我妈每天晚上都去跳有氧操，在那震耳欲聋的音乐里蹦蹦跳跳保持身材。

t: n. 爱情片；情感片
en: She cried her eyes out watching that old affectional film alone on Friday night.
cn: 周五晚上她一个人躲着看那部老掉牙的爱情片，哭得那叫一个惨。

t: n. 万圣节（诸圣瞻礼，11月1日）
en: In many cultures, All Saints' Day is when families visit graves to honor those who have passed away.
cn: 在很多文化里，大家会在万圣节这天去扫墓，以此来缅怀逝去的亲人。

t: n. 祭坛；圣坛；神台
en: He left me standing at the altar, and I realized right then that he was never ready to commit.
cn: 他就在婚礼现场把我一个人晾在那儿，那一刻我懂了，他压根没想好要结婚。
tip: alt(altitude高) + ar → 摆放祭品的高台 → 祭坛，圣坛
phr: lead to the altar 与…步入婚礼殿堂
sacrifice on the altar 牺牲在祭坛上

t: n. 紫水晶
en: She gave me an amethyst necklace for my birthday, saying it would bring me peace and clarity.
cn: 生日那天她送了我一条紫水晶项链，说是能让我心静，想事情更通透。
phr: raw amethyst 天然紫水晶
amethyst ring 紫水晶戒指

t: phr. 古建筑群
en: We hiked up the mountain to see the ancient architectural complex hidden in the mist.
cn: 我们爬了半天山，就为了看一眼藏在云雾里那片成片的古建筑群。

t: phr. 古墓
en: Archaeologists tread carefully inside the ancient tomb, afraid to disturb the silence that lasted a thousand years.
cn: 考古队员在古墓里走得小心翼翼，生怕惊扰了沉睡千年的寂静。

t: n. （超市）装袋员
en: He worked as a bag-packer on weekends to earn some extra pocket money.
cn: 他周末就在超市给人装袋子，虽然赚得不多，但也算给自己挣了点零花钱。

t: n. 宴会厅
en: The banquet hall was decorated with thousands of flowers, smelling sweet but feeling a bit suffocating.
cn: 宴会厅里堆了几千朵花，香是香，就是熏得人有点透不过气。

t: n. 腮红
en: She applied a little blusher to her cheeks to make herself look more awake after a long night.
cn: 熬了一通宵，她往脸上扫了点儿腮红提提气色，免得看着一脸菜色去开会。
tip: blush(脸红) + er(物) → 使面部变红之物 → 腮红
phr: apply blusher 涂抹腮红
powder blusher 腮红粉

t: 订票
en: I tried to book the ticket online, but the server crashed and I ended up missing the show.
cn: 我原本打算在网上订票，结果服务器崩了，害得我最后没看成演出。

t: n. 灌木丛林地；未开垦地
en: They are bulldozing the native bushland to build another generic shopping mall.
cn: 他们正在铲平这片原生灌木林，就为了再建个千篇一律的商场。
tip: bush(灌木) + land(土地) → 长满灌木之地 → 灌木丛林地
phr: native bushland 本土灌木林
cleared bushland 已开垦的灌木地

t: n. 白内障；大瀑布；急流；暴雨
en: Grandma took off the bandages after cataract surgery and happily said she could finally see her great-grandson clearly.
cn: 姥姥做完白内障手术拆了纱布，高兴地说终于能看清重孙子长什么样了，看着真让人感动。
tip: cata(向下) + ract(冲破) → 水流如帘幕下泻 → 大瀑布；白内障
phr: cataract surgery 白内障手术
cataracts of rain 倾盆倾泻的暴雨

t: n. 地峡；（由于低洼地或水上的）堤道；公路
en: Traffic on the causeway is jammed, so we won't make it to dinner on time.
cn: 堤道上的交通堵得死死的，晚饭我们肯定是赶不上了。
phr: coastal causeway 沿海堤道
cross the causeway 穿过堤道

t: n. 引体向上
en: He struggled to finish his last chin-up, his arms shaking violently as he tried to clear the bar.
cn: 他费了老劲想做完最后一个引体向上，过杠时两只胳膊抖得跟筛糠一样。

t: n. 沿海地区；海岸地带
en: The developer bought up huge chunks of coastland, planning to turn the quiet beach into a luxury resort.
cn: 开发商把那一带沿海地皮都包圆了，打算把这片清静海滩改成高档度假区。
tip: coast(海岸) + land(陆地) → 靠海的陆地地带 → 海岸地带
phr: fertile coastland 肥沃的沿海地带
inhabit the coastland 居住在海岸地带

t: n. 遮瑕膏；掩盖者；隐匿者
en: I slapped on three layers of concealer, trying to hide the fact that I stayed up all night.
cn: 我往脸上厚厚地涂了三层遮瑕膏，就为了掩盖昨晚通宵熬夜留下的黑眼圈。
tip: conceal(隐藏，掩盖) + er(物) → 遮蔽瑕疵之物 → 遮瑕膏
phr: apply concealer 涂抹遮瑕膏
liquid concealer 液体遮瑕液
under-eye concealer 眼下遮瑕产品

t: n. 鸡尾酒会
en: The cocktail party was just a bunch of people standing around with drinks, pretending to be more important than they are.
cn: 那场酒会挺虚伪的，一帮人端着杯子在那儿尬聊，都在那儿装大腕儿。

t: 珊瑚岛
en: They spent their honeymoon on a remote coral island, surrounded by crystal clear water and white sandy beaches.
cn: 他俩跑到一个偏僻的珊瑚岛上过蜜月去了，在那儿整天对着蓝得透亮的湖水晒太阳。

t: n. 侦探片
en: We spent the whole rainy Sunday watching an old detective film and trying to guess who the murderer was before the ending.
cn: 下雨的星期天，我们宅在家里看了一出老侦探片，在那儿瞎猜谁才是最后那个凶手。

t: n. 潜水；跳水
en: The stock market kept diving all week, and I was too scared to even check my portfolio.
cn: 股市这一周都在疯狂跳水，我吓得根本不敢看账户里还剩多少钱。
tip: dive(潜水/跳水) + ing → 扎入水中的运动 → 潜水；跳水
phr: scuba diving 水肺潜水
diving board 跳水板

t: n. 伦理片
en: They spent the evening watching a thought-provoking ethical film that explored the complex moral dilemmas of modern medicine.
cn: 俩人看了一晚上的伦理片，讲的是医生在手术台上那些两难的抉择，看完心里堵得慌，半天没说话。

t: n. 眼部凝胶
en: She applies eye gel every night to reduce the puffiness caused by staying up late working.
cn: 她每天雷打不动地涂眼部凝胶，就是想把熬夜加班熬出来的眼袋给消下去。

t: n. 眼罩
en: I always wear an eye mask on long flights to help me block out the light and sleep.
cn: 坐长途飞机我肯定得戴上眼罩，不然那灯晃得人根本没法眯一会儿。

t: n. 面膜
en: I love putting on a cooling facial mask after a long day at work to soothe my stressed skin.
cn: 辛苦工作了一整天，我最爱敷个凉爽的面膜，让紧绷的皮肤好好歇口气。

t: n. 年夜饭；团圆饭
en: For us, the family reunion dinner on New Year's Eve is the most important meal of the year.

t: n. 电影界
en: The latest scandal rocked the very foundations of filmdom, leaving fans gossiping and speculating about the careers of those involved.
cn: 最近这件丑闻把整个电影圈都给震动了，搞得粉丝们都在八卦，猜测那些涉事明星的星途会怎么样。
tip: film(电影) + dom(界/领域) → 电影界
phr: stars of filmdom 影坛明星
reign in filmdom 称霸电影界

t: n. 航班号
en: Please keep an eye on the departures board to see if your flight number has been assigned a boarding gate.
cn: 你盯着点大屏幕，看看咱那个航班号分配到哪个登机口了，别走错了。

t: n. 峡湾
en: The cruise ship sailed slowly through the narrow fiord, surrounded by massive cliffs and snowy peaks.
cn: 邮轮缓缓驶过狭窄的峡湾，两边全是陡峭的悬崖和雪山，景色特别壮观。
phr: Norwegian fiord 挪威峡湾
deep fiord 幽深的峡湾

t: noun. 耶稣受难日
en: Everything is closed because it's Good Friday, so we can't go shopping today.
cn: 今儿是耶稣受难日，店都关门了，咱没法去逛街。

t: n. 绿化带
en: The development was halted because the proposed building site was located within a protected greenbelt area.
cn: 项目被强行叫停了，因为那块地正好划在了受保护的绿化带里，谁也不敢动。
tip: green(绿色) + belt(带) → 环绕城镇的林带 → 绿化带
phr: urban greenbelt 城市绿化带
protect the greenbelt 保护绿化隔离带

t: n. 洞穴；岩穴；(作为景观的) 人工洞室
en: We swam into the blue grotto and the water was glowing beautifully.
cn: 我们游进了那个蓝洞，水面泛着幽光，美得简直不像真的。
phr: sea grotto 海蚀洞穴
artificial grotto 人工石洞

t: 护发素
en: I forgot to rinse the hair conditioner out properly, and now my hair feels incredibly greasy and heavy.
cn: 我刚才没把护发素冲干净，现在头发摸着腻得难受，沉甸甸的。

t: n. 护手霜
en: My skin gets so dry in the winter that I have to apply hand lotion every time I wash my hands.
cn: 一到冬天我手就起皮，回回洗完手都得赶紧抹点护手霜。

t: n. 悬挂式滑翔运动
en: For his 40th birthday, he decided to conquer his fear of heights by going hang gliding, which his wife thought was insane.

t: n. 徒步旅行；远足
en: We went hiking for six hours, and now my legs feel like jelly.
cn: 我们在山里徒步走了六个小时，现在我这两条腿酸得像灌了铅一样。
tip: hike(远足) + ing → 徒步旅行，远足
phr: go hiking 去徒步
hiking boots 登山靴
hiking trail 徒步路线

t: n. 丘陵地区
en: Farming in hilly areas requires a lot of manual labor, as large machinery cannot easily access the slopes.
cn: 丘陵地带种庄稼全靠人力，大机器根本开不上坡，活儿干起来特别吃力。

t: v. 搭便车旅行
en: They decided to hitch-hike to the music festival to save money on gas.
cn: 为了省点油钱，他们决定一路上拦便车去参加那个音乐节。

t: n. 温泉
en: This hidden hotspring is the perfect place to hide away from the crowds and enjoy some peace and quiet.
cn: 这处温泉特别隐蔽，正适合躲开人堆，图个清静。
tip: hot(热) + spring(泉水) → 涌出热水的泉 → 温泉
phr: hotspring resort 温泉度假胜地
soak in a hotspring 泡温泉

t: 非正式晚宴；便宴
en: It's just an informal dinner at my place, so there's no need to wear a suit; just come as you are.
cn: 就来我家随便吃个便饭，别穿西装那么正式，怎么舒服怎么来。

t: n. 小岛
en: We rented a small boat to explore the rocky islet, hoping to find some rare seabird nests.
cn: 我们租了条小船去探那个石头小岛，一门心思想要找找有没有稀罕的海鸟窝。
tip: isle(岛) + et(小) → 小岛屿 → 小岛
phr: rocky islet 礁石小岛
land on an islet 登上小岛

t: n. 唇彩；唇蜜
en: She applied a layer of shiny lip gloss before the date to give her lips a more hydrated and glowing look.
cn: 约会前她特意刷了一层亮晶晶的唇蜜，好让嘴唇看着水灵灵的。

t: n. 眼线液
en: Using liquid eye liner requires a steady hand, or you'll end up with a messy smear across your eyelid.
cn: 抹眼线液这活儿手千万不能抖，稍微一歪，眼皮上就得糊成个大熊猫。

t: n. 文艺片
en: We went to see a literary film last night, but the slow pace had me falling asleep halfway through.
cn: 昨晚去看了部文艺片，结果节奏太慢，我看到一半就开始打瞌睡了。

t: 阴历；农历
en: I always forget my birthday because my mom insists on using the lunar calendar.
cn: 我老是记不住生日，因为我妈非要按农历给我过，每年日子都不一样。

t: n. 卸妆液；卸妆产品
en: I'm so exhausted tonight that I almost went to bed without using any makeup remover.
cn: 今晚累得我半死，差点连妆都没卸就直接躺床上睡了。

t: n. 卸妆乳
en: This makeup removing lotion is very gentle and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin at all.
cn: 这款卸妆乳特别温和，涂在脸上一点都不扎，我这敏感肌用着正合适。

t: n. 武术；格斗技
en: He started practicing a martial art because he wanted to learn how to defend himself and gain some self-confidence.
cn: 他练起武术就是为了学点防身技巧，顺便也让自己变得更有自信。

t: n. 睫毛膏
en: I cried so hard during the movie that my mascara ran down my face like black tears.
cn: 看电影时我哭得稀里哗啦，睫毛膏顺着脸流下来，跟黑色的眼泪似的。
phr: apply mascara 涂睫毛膏
waterproof mascara 防水睫毛膏

t: n. 润肤霜；保湿乳液
en: My skin is so dry this winter that I have to slather on moisturizer three times a day.
cn: 今年冬天皮肤太干了，我一天得在那儿抹三遍润肤霜才行。
tip: moist(湿润) + urize + er → 补充水分之物 → 保湿润肤霜
phr: apply moisturizer 涂抹润肤霜
facial moisturizer 面部保湿乳

t: n. 慕斯（一种甜点）；摩丝（定型发胶）
en: I put too much mousse in my hair, and now it looks like a helmet.
cn: 我往头上抹了太多摩丝，现在头发硬得像顶了个月盔。
tip: 音译自法语“慕斯/摩丝” → 甜品慕斯；定型发胶
phr: chocolate mousse 巧克力慕斯
styling mousse 定型摩丝

t: n. 指甲油
en: She spent an hour applying her nail polish, only to smudge it immediately while searching for her car keys.
cn: 她费了一个小时才把指甲油涂好，结果翻个车钥匙的功夫就给蹭花了，真是白忙活。

t: n. 亭子；阁；临时展馆；（运动场的）选手席
en: We huddled in the pavilion waiting for the rain to stop, shivering in our wet clothes.
cn: 我们全挤在那个凉亭里躲雨，浑身湿透，冻得直哆嗦。
tip: 词源引申如“蝴蝶展翅的大棚” → 亭子，临时展馆
phr: national pavilion 国家展馆
set up a pavilion 搭建临时展馆

t: n. 粉饼
en: She quickly applied some pressed powder to her face to hide the shine before the photo.
cn: 拍照前她赶紧拿粉饼在脸上扑了扑，把那层油光给压了下去。

t: v. 提议祝酒；举杯庆贺
en: Let’s propose a toast to the newlyweds and wish them a long and happy life together.
cn: 咱们一起举杯敬这对新人，祝他们往后的日子过得和和美美，白头到老。

t: n. 斋月（伊斯兰历九月）
en: My roommate is observing Ramadan, so we wait until sunset to have a huge feast together.
cn: 室友在过斋月，所以我们都等到太阳下山才凑在一起吃顿大餐。
phr: observe Ramadan 守斋月
holy month of Ramadan 神圣斋月
fast during Ramadan 斋月把斋

t: n. 茶点；点心和饮料；提神之物
en: I only showed up to the meeting because I heard there would be refreshments.
cn: 我之所以来开这个会，完全是听说现场有茶点可以蹭。

t: n. 居民区；住宅区
en: Please don't rev your engine; this is a quiet residential area and people are trying to sleep.
cn: 别在这轰油门，这可是住宅区，大伙儿都睡着觉呢。

t: n. 红宝石；深红色
en: She lost the ruby from her ring and panic-searched the carpet.
cn: 戒指上的红宝石掉了，她急得趴在地毯上一通乱找。
phr: ruby red 红宝石色
ruby ring 红宝石戒指

t: n. 安息日（犹太教和基督教的休息日）；休息时间
en: Don't bother calling him on Saturday; he strictly observes the Sabbath.
cn: 周六别给他打电话，他雷打不动要过安息日。
phr: keep the Sabbath 守安息日
breach of the Sabbath 违反安息日戒律

t: n. 蓝宝石；蔚蓝色
en: He bought a ring with a tiny sapphire because diamonds were way out of budget.
cn: 他买了枚镶着小蓝宝石的戒指，因为钻石实在超出了预算。
phr: sapphire blue 蔚蓝色
sapphire ring 蓝宝石戒指

t: n. 水肺潜水
en: We went scuba diving off the coast, drifting past coral reefs while colorful fish darted around our masks.
cn: 我们去海边潜了水，顺着水流飘过珊瑚礁，看着五颜六色的鱼在面罩前窜来窜去。

t: n. 忏悔星期二 (又称“煎饼日”)
en: I completely forgot it was Shrove Tuesday, so now I feel a bit left out seeing everyone's pancake pictures online.
cn: 我完全忘了今天是忏悔星期二，结果上网看到大家都在晒煎饼的照片，感觉自己错过了全世界。

t: n. 快餐柜台；小吃店
en: Let's grab a hot dog at the snack bar before the movie starts.
cn: 趁电影还没开场，咱们先去小卖部顺个热狗吃吧。

t: n. 武侠片
en: Watching an old swordsmen film makes me miss the days when special effects were simple but the fighting felt real.
cn: 看这种老武侠片真让人怀念，那时候特效虽简陋，但打戏看着是真带劲。

t: n. 聚光灯之旅（指备受瞩目的巡演）
en: The band is exhausted from their spotlight tour and just wants to sleep for a week.
cn: 乐队跑完这趟备受瞩目的巡演都累瘫了，只想睡上一周。

t: n. 钟乳石（从上往下垂的）
en: Water dripped from the sharp stalactite hanging above us, echoing in the silent cave.
cn: 水珠顺着头顶尖尖的钟乳石滴下来，在寂静的山洞里只有回声。
tip: stala + c(ceiling天花板) + tite → 从顶部垂下的钟乳石
phr: stalactites and stalagmites 钟乳石与石笋
hanging stalactites 倒挂的钟乳石

t: n. 石笋（从下往上长的）
en: Be careful not to trip over that stalagmite rising from the cave floor like a stone spike.
cn: 小心别被地上冒出来像石钉一样的石笋绊倒了。
tip: stala + g(ground地面) + mite → 从地面往上长的石笋
phr: towering stalagmite 高耸的石笋
grow into a stalagmite 凝聚长成石笋

t: 熬夜
en: Staying up late to binge-watch series made me feel like a zombie during the morning meeting.
cn: 昨晚熬大夜追剧，结果今天早上开会时我整个人都是飘的，脑子转不动。

t: n. 发胶；定型啫喱
en: He applied a generous amount of styling gel to make sure his hair stayed perfectly in place all night.
cn: 他往头上抹了一大坨发胶，就为了让发型能挺住，哪怕玩一晚上也不乱。

t: n. 避暑胜地
en: This mountain town is a popular summer resort because the temperature stays cool all year round.
cn: 这座山城是出名的避暑好地方，就算大夏天也凉快得很，舒服极了。

t: n. 茶话会；下午茶聚会
en: I am too tired to make polite conversation at a tea party.
cn: 我今天累得半死，实在没力气去茶话会上跟那帮人假客套。

t: n. 长焦镜头；远摄镜头
en: He attached a massive telephoto lens to capture the birds feeding in the distance.
cn: 他给相机装上那个巨大的长焦镜头，只为了拍到远处鸟儿觅食的瞬间。

t: 节日名. 元宵节
en: We stuffed ourselves with sweet dumplings during The Lantern Festival until we couldn't move.
cn: 元宵节那天我们拼命塞汤圆，撑得连路都走不动了。

t: n. 导游；旅游指南
en: Our tourist guide had a funny accent but knew all the best hidden food spots.
cn: 咱们那个导游口音挺逗，但找那些藏在巷子里的美食店可真是一绝。

t: n. 旅行社
en: We booked through a travel agency to save time, but they still messed up our hotel reservations.
cn: 为了省事找了旅行社订票，结果他们还是把我们的酒店预订搞砸了。

t: n. 热带雨林
en: We trekked deep into the tropical rain forest, sweating buckets while the canopy blocked out the sun.
cn: 我们深一脚浅一脚地往热带雨林里钻，汗流浃背，头顶的树冠把太阳挡得严严实实。

t: n. 水球运动
en: Playing water polo is exhausting; you have to tread water while wrestling for the ball.
cn: 打水球太累人了，一边踩水还得一边跟人抢球，体力跟不上真不行。

t: n. 滑水运动
en: My arms are sore from water skiing; holding onto that rope is a serious workout.
cn: 滑完水胳膊酸得抬不起来，死死抓住那根绳子简直是受罪。

t: n. 连环追尾；连环相撞
en: Fog on the highway caused a chain collision involving twenty cars.
cn: 高速上雾太大了，二十辆车撞成了一团，现场那叫一个惨烈。

t: n. 机场大巴；机场豪华轿车
en: We missed the last train, so we had to catch the airport limousine to get downtown before midnight.
cn: 我们错过了末班地铁，只好去赶那趟机场大巴，好在午夜前到了市区。

t: n. 机场税
en: They usually include the airport tax in the ticket price now, so you don't need to worry about cash.
cn: 现在机场税通常都直接算在票价里了，你不用操心还要准备现金。

t: n. 机场航站楼
en: I realized I was at the wrong airport terminal ten minutes before boarding, and my heart just sank.
cn: 登机前十分钟我才发现跑错了航站楼，当时心真的是凉了半截。

t: phrase. 主干道交通；干道车流
en: Avoid the main artery traffic at 5 PM, or you'll be stuck for hours.
cn: 下午五点千万别走主干道，不然堵在车流里几个小时都动不了。

t: n. 自动交通信号灯
en: When the automatic traffic signal light failed, the intersection turned into complete chaos.
cn: 那个自动红绿灯一坏，整个十字路口瞬间乱成了一锅粥。

t: n. 汽车工业
en: The automobile industry is shifting to electric power, leaving traditional mechanics worried.
cn: 汽车行业都在往电动化转，搞得修传统车的技工心里直发慌。

t: n. 停泊处；（船或火车上的）铺位；v. 停泊
en: The sleeping berth was so cramped I couldn't even turn over all night.
cn: 卧铺那个床位窄得要命，我整整一宿愣是翻不了身。
phr: sleeping berth 卧铺铺位
give a wide berth 敬而远之
berth at the pier 停靠码头

t: n. 登机牌
en: I realized I had left my boarding card at the coffee shop just as the gate was opening.
cn: 登机口都开了，我才反应过来把登机牌落刚才喝咖啡那地儿了，急得我满头大汗。

t: 颠簸的航程
en: It was a terribly bumpy flight through the storm, and I gripped the armrest the whole time, feeling quite nauseous.
cn: 飞机穿过风暴区的时候颠得不行，我全程都紧紧抓着扶手，感觉快吐了。

t: n. (飞机) 商务舱
en: Once you stretch your legs in business class, flying economy feels like torture.
cn: 只要体验过能伸直腿的商务舱，再回去坐经济舱简直就是受罪。

t: 粗心驾驶；危险驾驶
en: He got a hefty fine for careless driving after he was caught texting on his phone and swerving between lanes.
cn: 他因为一边开车一边发短信，还在车道间乱晃，被开了张危险驾驶的巨额罚单。

t: n. 车行道
en: A huge truck had broken down in the middle of the carriage-way, causing a massive traffic jam that stretched for miles.
cn: 一辆大卡车在车行道中央抛锚了，造成了绵延数英里的严重交通堵塞。

t: n. 中转航班；接通航班
en: We almost missed our connecting flight in Dubai because our first plane took off late.
cn: 因为头一班飞机起飞晚了，咱们差点在迪拜没赶上转机的航班。

t: n. 十字路口；人生转折点
en: After the company went bankrupt, Mark found himself at a cross road in his professional life.
cn: 公司倒闭后，马克觉得自己的职业生涯走到了一个必须做抉择的分叉路口。

t: n. 巡航速度
en: Once the airplane reached its cruising speed, the flight attendants started serving drinks and snacks to the passengers.
cn: 等飞机进入巡航状态飞稳了，空姐才开始给大伙儿发饮料和零食。

t: n. 弯道
en: You need to slow down when approaching a curve road, or you'll lose control of the car.
cn: 看到前面有弯道你得赶紧点下刹车，不然车速太快，非得冲出路基不可。

t: 危险驾驶
en: His license was suspended for dangerous driving after he was caught speeding in a school zone.
cn: 他在学校附近飙车被抓了，因为危险驾驶，驾照直接被吊销了。

t: n. 直飞航班
en: We decided to book a direct flight to Tokyo so we wouldn't have to deal with the stress of connecting in Shanghai.
cn: 我们决定订直飞东京的票，这样就不用在上海折腾转机，省得心累。

t: n. (英)(中间有分隔带的)双车道公路
en: Driving on the dual carriage-way at night is much less stressful because you don't have headlights from oncoming traffic blinding you.

t: n. <美> 酒后驾车；受影响驾驶 (Driving Under the Influence)
en: He lost his license after getting a DUI on his way home from the bar.
cn: 他从酒吧回家的路上因为酒驾被抓，驾照都被吊销了。
tip: Driving Under the Influence 首字母缩写 → 酒驾
phr: arrested for DUI 因酒驾被捕
DUI checkpoint 酒驾检查站
DUI conviction 酒后驾驶定罪

t: 免税店
en: I always get tempted by the duty-free shop at the airport, but I have to remind myself that I don't actually need another bottle of perfume.
cn: 我每次在机场都忍不住想逛免税店，但我得时刻提醒自己，我真没必要再买一瓶香水了。

t: 经济舱
en: I always book economy class for short flights because, honestly, the discomfort is temporary but the money saved is real.
cn: 飞短途我肯定选经济舱，说实话，那点不舒服忍忍就过去了，但省下来的钱可是实实在在的。

t: adj. 节能的
en: I replaced all the old light bulbs with energy-saving LEDs to try and lower our electricity costs.
cn: 我把屋里那几盏费电的旧灯全给换成节能灯了，就是想看看下个月电费能不能少点。

t: n. 头等舱；一等；优秀
en: I was luckily upgraded to first class on the long-haul flight, so I finally managed to get some decent sleep.
cn: 运气爆棚，长途飞行竟然给我升到了头等舱，总算能躺平了安稳睡一觉。

t: n. 转机中心
en: I spent three hours wandering around the flight connection centre because my next plane was delayed.
cn: 因为飞机晚点，我在转机中心晃悠了三个小时，腿都快走细了。

t: n. 迫降
en: The pilot had to make a forced landing in a field after the engine failed suddenly.
cn: 引擎半路突然熄火了，飞行员没法子，只能硬着头皮降落在农田里。

t: n. 路标；指路杆；指导原则
en: We followed every guide post along the trail, but the heavy fog still made us lose our way home.
cn: 虽然我们盯着路标走，但雾实在太大，最后还是迷路了。

t: 迎面碰撞；正面冲突
en: The two cars were involved in a terrifying head-on collision because one driver fell asleep at the wheel.
cn: 就因为有个司机开车打了个盹，结果两辆车迎头撞在了一起，场面看着特别吓人。

t: 肇事逃逸
en: The police are looking for a silver sedan involved in a hit and run last night.
cn: 警察正在全城搜捕昨晚那辆撞了人就跑的银色轿车。

t: n. 辅助车道
en: Use the lane auxiliary if you need to slow down before taking the highway exit.
cn: 准备下高速前，先开进这条辅助车道减减速，别直接在主路刹车。

t: n. （旅途中的）短暂停留；转机停留
en: I had an eight-hour layover in Dubai and spent all my money on duty-free chocolate.
cn: 在迪拜转机等了八个小时，闲得无聊，把钱全花在免税店买巧克力了。
tip: lay(搁置/停放) + over → 旅程中停歇 → 转机停留
phr: four-hour layover 四小时转机停留
have a layover in 在某地中途停留

t: n. 轻轨
en: Taking the light rail is much faster than driving during rush hour when the main roads are completely blocked.
cn: 赶上早晚高峰路都堵死了，还不如坐轻轨呢，起码不用在马路上闻汽车尾气。

t: 预订
en: If you don't make a reservation at that restaurant weeks in advance, you’ll end up waiting for hours in the cold.
cn: 那家餐厅你要不提前几个礼拜订位子，就只能在冷风里老老实实排上好几个钟头了。

t: n. 夜间服务；夜班班次
en: If your internet cuts out late at night, the provider offers a 24-hour night service to help fix it.
cn: 就算大半夜断网了也别急，运营商有24小时值班的服务，打个电话他们就能帮你看看。

t: 禁止车辆穿行
en: They put up a 'no through traffic' sign to stop drivers from cutting through our quiet residential street, and it has been so peaceful since.

t: n. 直飞航班
en: A fourteen-hour non-stop flight sounds efficient until your legs go completely numb.
cn: 十四小时的直飞听着挺高效，坐下来你就知道腿都不是自己的了。

t: 仅限单程；只准单向
en: This friendship feels like a 'one way only' street; I'm always the one reaching out and making plans.

t: adj. 过度拥挤的；人满为患的
en: The subway was so overcrowded I suffocated; my feet dangled for three stops, held up solely by the crowd.
cn: 早高峰的地铁简直overcrowded到窒息，我脚离地悬空了三站路，全靠周围的人夹着我。
tip: over(过度) + crowd(拥挤) + ed → 过度拥挤的
phr: overcrowded classroom 拥挤的教室
relieve overcrowded conditions 缓解拥挤状况

t: n. 哑剧；手势；童话剧
en: We didn't speak the language, so ordering dinner turned into a confused pantomime of chickens and cows.
cn: 我们语言不通，点菜的时候只能在那儿手舞足蹈地比划鸡和牛，看着特乱。
tip: panto(全部) + mime(哑剧/模仿) → 全靠模仿动作表演 → 哑剧
phr: in dumb pantomime 用无声哑剧手势
Christmas pantomime 圣诞童话剧
express through pantomime 借助手势表达

t: n. 露天停车场
en: We drove around the parking lot for twenty minutes and still couldn't find a single empty spot.
cn: 我们在停车场转悠了二十分钟，愣是没找着一个能塞下车的空位。

t: 停车许可证
en: After a month of paperwork, I finally got the residential parking permit, which was such a ridiculous hassle.

t: n. （单行车道上的）会车处
en: Driving on that narrow country road was so stressful; I had to pull into a passing bay every few minutes to let other cars go by.
cn: 在那条乡间小路上开车真是心累，每隔几分钟就得拐进会车点，让对面的车先过去。

t: 飞机票
en: I just found a ridiculously cheap plane ticket for next weekend, and now I have to convince my boss to give me a day off.

t: n. 私人交通工具
en: The exorbitant cost of private transport in the city center forced me to sell my car and rely solely on the subway.
cn: 市中心的私家车开销实在太吓人了，逼得我只能把车卖了，天天挤地铁。

t: n. 公共交通
en: Parking in the city center is a nightmare, so I prefer taking public transport to get to work.
cn: 市中心停车简直是场噩梦，所以我上班宁愿去挤公交地铁。

t: n. 普尔曼式火车卧铺车厢；豪华轿车
en: Traveling in a vintage Pullman car makes you feel like you've stepped back into the 1920s.
cn: 坐在这种老式豪华卧铺车厢里，感觉就像穿越回了上世纪二十年代。
tip: pull(拉) + man(人) → 火车拉着旅客舒适出行的专列 → 卧铺车厢；豪华轿车
phr: Pullman car 普尔曼卧铺车厢
Pullman porter 卧铺车厢乘务员

t: 公路交叉口；路口
en: He missed the turn because the GPS got confused at the complicated road junction, and we ended up driving in circles.
cn: 他开过了那个转弯，因为导航在那个复杂的路口彻底乱了，结果我们一直在原地兜圈子。

t: 公路网（复数）
en: The storm severely damaged the regional road networks, making it extremely difficult to deliver emergency supplies to the isolated villages.
cn: 暴风雨严重破坏了该地区的公路网，导致救援物资很难运到那些被隔绝的村庄里。

t: n. 往返航程；来回旅行
en: The round trip to the mountains took us nearly eight hours, leaving us completely exhausted by Sunday night.
cn: 这一趟进山来回折腾了快八个钟头，等周日晚上到家时，我累得倒头就能睡着。

t: n. (马路上的) 安全岛
en: The traffic was so crazy that we had to wait on the safety island for five minutes just to cross.
cn: 车流实在太疯了，我们躲在安全岛上足足等了五分钟才敢过马路。

t: n. 优惠票；省钱票
en: I managed to grab a saver ticket for the train by booking three weeks in advance.
cn: 我提前三周就把火车票订好了，抢到了一张特价票，便宜了不少。

t: n. 班车；接驳车
en: The shuttle bus runs every ten minutes, so we won't wait long in the cold.
cn: 接驳车十分钟一趟，我们不用在冷风里等太久。

t: n. 单行；一列纵队
en: The teacher shouted at the excited kids to form a single line before getting on the bus.
cn: 老师冲着那帮兴奋的孩子大喊，让他们排成一列纵队再上车。

t: n. 轻微碰撞；轻微影响
en: Luckily, the two cars only had a slight impact, so there was no serious damage to either of the bumpers.
cn: 还好那两辆车只是轻轻蹭了一下，保险杠都没怎么坏，虚惊一场，真是万幸。

t: n. 限速；最高速限制
en: He completely ignored the speed limit and saw the police lights flashing behind him instantly.
cn: 他完全没把限速牌放在眼里，结果没开多远，就在后视镜里看见了闪烁的警灯。

t: n. 陡坡
en: My old car groaned as it struggled to climb that steep hill.
cn: 我那辆破车爬这个陡坡时直哼哼，根本跑不动。

t: （飞机等）爬升；增加高度
en: The plane started to gain height rapidly to avoid the thick storm clouds ahead.
cn: 飞机为了躲开前面的厚云层，开始加速往上爬升。

t: 交通拥堵；塞车
en: I missed the flight because the traffic congestion on the bridge was a total nightmare.
cn: 大桥上堵车堵成了噩梦，害得我直接误了机。

t: n. 交通管制；交通控制
en: The police implemented strict traffic control near the stadium to ensure that the fans could leave the concert safely.
cn: 交警在体育馆附近封了路，就为了让看完演唱会的歌迷们能顺顺当当地回家。

t: n. 交警
en: A friendly traffic police officer helped the elderly woman cross the busy intersection during the chaotic rush hour.
cn: 晚高峰乱成一锅粥，还好有个交警心细，扶着那位老奶奶稳稳当当地过了马路。

t: n. 交通条例；交通管理规则
en: Every citizen is expected to follow traffic regulation to ensure the safety of both pedestrians and drivers on the road.
cn: 大家都得守规矩开车，不然这马路上乱套了，谁的生命安全都保不住。

t: 双向交通；往复式交流
en: Be careful when crossing here because this narrow alley has suddenly been turned into two-way traffic.
cn: 过这条小巷子得留神点，现在改成双向通车了，冷不丁就会从拐角窜出个车来。

t: n. 空座
en: I scanned the crowded train hoping for a vacant seat, but I ended up standing for an hour.
cn: 我在挤死人的火车上扫了一圈想找个空座，结果最后还是站了一小时。

t: n. 违规者；侵犯者
en: The traffic camera captures every violator speeding through the red light.
cn: 交通摄像头把每一个闯红灯的家伙都拍了个正着。
tip: violate(违反，侵犯) + or(人) → 违规者，侵犯者
phr: repeat violator 屡犯者
penalize violators 处罚违章者

t: n. 蜿蜒的道路
en: Driving on this narrow and winding road requires full concentration, especially when there are no streetlights at night.
cn: 在这种绕来绕去的窄路上开车得打起十二分精神，尤其是晚上连个路灯都没有，更悬。

t: n. 斑马纹
en: The fashion designer incorporated bold zebra stripes into his latest collection to create a striking impact.
cn: 设计师在最新款衣服里加了大面积的斑马纹，视觉冲击力特别强。

t: n. 芦笋
en: She grilled the asparagus with garlic, but the kids still refused to touch anything green.
cn: 她特意加蒜烤了芦笋，可孩子们一看是绿色的，死活都不肯动筷子。
phr: fresh asparagus 新鲜芦笋
roasted asparagus 烤芦笋

t: n. 甜菜；红菜头
en: Her face turned as red as a beet when she realized her microphone was on.
cn: 发现麦克风没关，她的脸瞬间红得像个甜菜头。
phr: sugar beet 糖用甜菜
red as a beet 满脸通红

t: n. 蚕豆
en: My grandma adds broad beans to her stew, giving it a rich and earthy flavor.
cn: 姥姥炖肉的时候喜欢放点蚕豆，那味儿特别浓郁，吃着特香。

t: n. 西兰花；花椰菜
en: My toddler threw the steamed broccoli on the floor and looked at me like I had poisoned him.
cn: 我家娃把蒸西兰花扔在地上，看着我的眼神就像我给他下了毒。
phr: steamed broccoli 清蒸西兰花
broccoli florets 西兰花小花头

t: n. 腰果
en: I accidentally ate a cashew nut and had to rush to find my allergy medicine.
cn: 我不小心吃了颗腰果，吓得赶紧到处找抗过敏药。

t: n. 芹菜
en: My diet says I can only snack on celery, which basically tastes like crunchy water.
cn: 减肥食谱说我只能拿芹菜当零食，这玩意儿吃起来就像嘎嘣脆的白开水。
phr: celery stalk 芹菜茎
crisp celery 清脆的芹菜

t: n. 细叶芹；山萝卜
en: I sprinkled some finely chopped chervil over the soup to give it a mild, anise-like flavor before serving.
cn: 出锅前我撒了把碎欧芹叶，汤里瞬间多了股淡淡的清香味。
phr: fresh chervil 新鲜细叶芹
chopped chervil 细叶芹碎末

t: n. 细香葱
en: She sprinkled some freshly chopped chive over the baked potato to add a bit of color and flavor.
cn: 她在烤土豆上撒了点刚切好的小香葱，看着更有食欲，吃起来也香。
phr: chopped chives 细香葱碎
sour cream and chives 酸奶油香葱味

t: n. 苹果酒；苹果汁
en: There is nothing better than hot apple cider to warm you up on a freezing night.
cn: 这种大冷天，喝杯热苹果酒暖暖身子，简直没有比这更爽的了。
phr: sparkling cider 气泡苹果酒
hot apple cider 热苹果汁

t: n. 干红葡萄酒（特指波尔多红葡萄酒）；深紫红色
en: She spilled a glass of expensive claret on the white carpet, and the host's face went pale instantly.
cn: 她把一杯昂贵的波尔多红酒洒在了白地毯上，主人的脸瞬间就吓白了。
tip: clar(clear清澈) + et(小) → 澄清透亮的高档红酒 → 干红葡萄酒
phr: glass of claret 一杯波尔多干红
claret jug 红酒壶

t: n. 鳕鱼；愚弄；v. 欺骗
en: I thought I ordered fancy seafood, but one bite told me it was just cheap frozen cod.
cn: 本以为那是高档海鲜，结果尝了一口发现就是普通的冷冻鳕鱼，太坑了。
phr: cod liver oil 鱼肝油
Atlantic cod 大西洋鳕鱼

t: n. 科涅克白兰地（法国干邑）
en: He poured a glass of cognac to celebrate, but ended up ranting about his ex all night.
cn: 他倒了杯干邑想庆祝一下，结果喝着喝着就开始吐槽了一整晚的前任。
phr: sip cognac 细品干邑白兰地
glass of vintage cognac 一杯陈年干邑

t: n. 水田芥；西洋菜
en: She added some fresh cress to the egg sandwiches to give them a slightly peppery and crunchy texture.
cn: 她在鸡蛋三明治里随手撒了点西洋菜，吃起来脆生生的，还有点淡淡的辛辣味。
phr: garden cress 水芹；苦苣菜
egg and cress sandwich 鸡蛋西洋菜三明治

t: n. 孜然；枯茗
en: The soul of lamb skewers is the cumin; without it, the meat just doesn't taste right.
cn: 烤羊肉串的灵魂就是那把孜然，要是没撒到位，吃着总觉得少股劲儿。
phr: ground cumin 孜然粉
cumin seeds 孜然粒

t: n. 咖喱鸡
en: My mom's curried chicken is so spicy it makes my eyes water, but I can't stop eating it.
cn: 我妈做的咖喱鸡辣得我直冒眼泪，可我这嘴就是停不下来，太下饭了。

t: 虾米；海米
en: My grandma's secret soup recipe gets its unique savory flavor from a handful of dried shrimps she adds to the broth.

t: n. 茴香
en: I hate the taste of fennel; it ruins the whole salad for me.
cn: 我最讨厌茴香那个味儿了，这一盘沙拉全让它给毁了。
phr: fennel seeds 茴香籽
fresh fennel bulb 新鲜茴香球茎

t: n. 小酸黄瓜
en: The burger was okay, but I really hated the soggy gherkin inside.
cn: 那汉堡味道还行，就是里面那块软塌塌的酸黄瓜让我反胃，直接挑出去了。
phr: pickled gherkins 腌制小酸黄瓜
crunchy gherkin 爽脆小黄瓜

t: n. 金菲士（一种鸡尾酒）
en: I ordered a refreshing gin fizz to cool down after spending the entire afternoon walking in the sun.
cn: 在太阳底下走了一下午，我赶紧点了一杯清爽的金菲士消消暑。

t: n. 味精
en: My grandma swears by a pinch of gourmet powder in her stir-fries, claiming it's the secret to making everything taste better.
cn: 我奶奶坚信炒菜时放一小撮味精是她让所有菜都变好吃的秘诀。

t: n. 鲱鱼
en: The smell of that fermented herring tin was so strong it almost made me throw up.
cn: 那罐鲱鱼罐头刚一打开，那股恶臭味就把我熏得差点把隔夜饭吐出来。
phr: red herring 转移注意力的障眼法
pickled herring 腌制鲱鱼

t: n. 羽衣甘蓝
en: I put a handful of kale in my smoothie, and now the whole thing tastes like grass.
cn: 我往奶昔里抓了一把羽衣甘蓝，好嘛，现在整杯喝起来跟吃草似的。
phr: kale salad 羽衣甘蓝沙拉
curly kale 皱叶甘蓝

t: n. 苤蓝；大头菜
en: My grandmother always uses kohlrabi to make crunchy pickles that go perfectly with breakfast porridge.
cn: 我奶奶老拿苤蓝腌咸菜，吃起来嘎嘣脆，早晨就着稀饭吃那叫一个香。
phr: raw kohlrabi 生苤蓝
slice kohlrabi 切苤蓝片

t: n. 猪油；润滑油；v. 涂猪油于；润色
en: Grandma swears that cooking with lard makes the crust flakier.
cn: 奶奶发誓说，用猪油做出来的酥皮才够掉渣。
phr: pure lard 纯猪油
lard with quotes 大量穿插引用

t: n. 月桂树；桂冠；殊荣
en: You can't just rest on your laurels after one success; you have to keep working.
cn: 你不能光凭一次成功就躺在功劳簿上睡大觉，还得接着干呢。
phr: rest on one's laurels 固步自封吃老本
win laurels 赢得殊荣桂冠
laurel wreath 月桂花环

t: n. 韭葱（一种蔬菜，似大葱）
en: I tossed some chopped green onions into the potato soup to give it a bit of a kick.
cn: 我往土豆汤里扔了点切好的韭葱，好让味道提提鲜。
phr: potato and leek soup 韭葱土豆汤
wild leek 野韭葱

t: n. 柠檬汁
en: Adding a few drops of fresh lemon juice to the grilled fish can really bring out the natural sweetness of the seafood.
cn: 烤鱼的时候挤上几滴新鲜柠檬汁，能把鱼肉本身的鲜甜味儿都给提出来。

t: n. 小扁豆；兵豆
en: Since going vegan, she puts lentil soup on the menu every single night.
cn: 自从吃素以来，她每晚都要煮扁豆汤，我真的快吃吐了。
phr: lentil soup 扁豆汤
red lentils 红扁豆

t: n. 烈性甜酒；利口酒
en: We sipped some cherry liqueur after dinner, thinking it was weak, but it hit us hard an hour later.
cn: 饭后我们抿了点樱桃利口酒，以为这甜酒没啥劲儿，结果过了一小时后劲上来全倒了。
tip: 形似 liquid(液体) → 特调的浓甜酒液 → 烈性甜酒，利口酒
phr: coffee liqueur 咖啡利口酒
sip a liqueur 抿一口利口酒

t: n. 人造黄油；麦淇淋
en: My grandmother insists that the cookies taste better with butter, refusing to use margarine.
cn: 我奶奶非说用黄油烤饼干更香，死活不肯用人造黄油。
phr: spread margarine 涂抹人造黄油
tub of margarine 一盒麦淇淋

t: n. 骨髓；精华；（英）西葫芦
en: The roasted bone marrow on toast was so rich that I couldn't finish it.
cn: 烤骨髓配吐司实在太腻了，我根本吃不完。
phr: bone marrow 骨髓
chill to the marrow 寒透骨髓
vegetable marrow 西葫芦

t: n. 矿泉水
en: I ordered a bottle of mineral water because my stomach couldn't handle any more alcohol after last night.
cn: 我就要了一瓶矿泉水，昨晚喝得太猛，现在胃里根本装不下一点酒。

t: n. 橙汁
en: I always start my morning with a fresh glass of orange juice to give myself a little boost.
cn: 每天早上我都要喝杯鲜榨橙汁，好让自己打起精神，开启新的一天。

t: n. 蚝油
en: He added a bit too much oyster sauce to the stir-fry, and now the whole dish tastes overwhelmingly salty and weird.
cn: 他炒菜的时候蚝油好像放得有点多，现在整盘菜咸得发齁，味道怪怪的。

t: n. 欧芹；香芹（常用作装饰菜）
en: You have a giant piece of parsley stuck in your teeth, making it hard to take you seriously.
cn: 你牙缝里塞了一大片欧芹叶子，搞得我看着你就想笑，根本严肃不起来。
phr: chopped parsley 欧芹碎
garnish with parsley 用欧芹点缀

t: 花生酱
en: I tried making a fancy sandwich for lunch, but I ended up just eating peanut butter straight from the jar because I was too lazy.

t: n. （装猪用的）猪袋；一种皮包
en: The farmer wrestled the squealing animal into a sturdy pig bag, a task that looked surprisingly difficult and left him covered in mud.
cn: 农夫费了九牛二虎之力才把那头尖叫的猪塞进一个结实的猪袋里，这活儿看起来难得要命，还搞得他满身是泥。

t: n. （西班牙）甜椒
en: He ordered the fancy olives that were stuffed with bright red pimiento, adding a mild, sweet flavor to his boring salad.

t: n. 萝卜；小萝卜
en: She sliced a crunchy radish into the salad to give it a little spicy kick.
cn: 她往沙拉里切了个脆生生的小萝卜，想给这盘草提提味儿，带点辣劲儿。
phr: pickled radish 腌萝卜
crisp radish 清脆的萝卜

t: n. 红枣
en: My mom always adds red date to her soup, insisting it's good for my health, though I just think it adds a nice sweetness.
cn: 我妈煮汤总爱往里面放红枣，非说对身体好，不过我觉得就是让汤喝起来有股淡淡的甜味。

t: n. 红酒
en: After a disastrous day at work, I just wanted to go home, pour a large glass of red wine, and forget everything.
cn: 工作上搞砸了一堆事，我现在什么都不想，就想回家倒上一大杯红酒，把这些烦心事都忘了。

t: adj. 经验丰富的；调过味的；风干的
en: As a seasoned traveler, she knew exactly how to pack light for a month-long trip.
cn: 作为一名在路上跑惯了的老手，她太清楚怎么只带一点行李就去玩一个月了。
tip: season(季节/风霜) + ed → 历经四时历练的 → 经验丰富的
phr: seasoned traveler 经验丰富的旅行家
seasoned wood 经风干的木材
well seasoned 调味恰当的

t: n. 紫菜汤；海带汤
en: My mom made me seaweed soup for my birthday, as is the tradition in our family.
cn: 过生日的时候，我妈照家里的老规矩给我煮了碗海带汤。

t: n. 芝麻酱（多指西式或纯芝麻泥）
en: Noodles just taste better when you mix in plenty of rich sesame butter and chili oil.
cn: 面条里多拌点香浓的芝麻酱和辣椒油，吃起来才够味。

t: n. 虾酱；虾油
en: The smell of this shrimp sauce is strong, but it makes the stir-fry taste amazing.
cn: 这虾酱闻着冲鼻，但炒起菜来那是真香。

t: n. 刀削面
en: I always order a large bowl of sliced noodles from that street stall because they are so chewy and satisfying.
cn: 我总爱去那家摊子点大碗刀削面，面条劲道得很，吃完心里特别踏实，一天都有劲儿。

t: n. 烟熏培根；熏咸肉
n. 酱油
en: The soup tasted too bland, so I added a splash of soy sauce to enhance the flavor.
cn: 汤喝起来太淡了，我加了一点酱油提提鲜，味道才刚好。

t: n. 豆酱；黄豆酱
en: Adding a spoonful of soybean paste gave the stew a much richer, savory flavor.
cn: 往炖菜里加了一勺黄豆酱后，那味道立马就变得浓郁鲜香了。

t: n. 鱿鱼；乌贼
en: This grilled squid is way too chewy; it feels like I'm eating a rubber band.
cn: 这烤鱿鱼也太老了，嚼起来感觉像是在吃橡皮筋。
phr: giant squid 大王乌贼
fried squid 炸鱿鱼圈
squid ink 墨鱼汁

t: n. 臭豆腐
en: You can smell the stinky tofu from a block away; it smells like garbage but tastes like heaven.
cn: 隔着一条街就能闻到那臭豆腐味儿，闻着像垃圾堆，吃进嘴里却是人间美味。

t: n. 食盐
en: The soup was a bit bland, so I added a pinch of table salt to bring out the flavor.
cn: 锅里这汤喝着没什么味儿，我往里撒了撮盐，这下总算鲜亮多了。

t: n. 餐具
en: After the big party, it took us over an hour just to wash and dry all the tableware.
cn: 聚会散场以后，光是洗碗、擦干那一大堆餐具，就折腾了我们一个多钟头。
tip: table(餐桌) + ware(器皿) → 餐具
phr: disposable tableware 一次性餐具
set the tableware 摆放餐具

t: n. 百里香；麝香草（一种烹饪用香草）
en: The recipe calls for fresh thyme, but I only have the dried stuff in my pantry.
cn: 食谱上非要用新鲜百里香，可我柜子里只有干货，只能凑合用了。
phr: sprig of thyme 一小枝百里香
season with thyme 用百里香调味

t: 番茄酱；浓缩番茄泥
en: To make the pasta sauce richer and thicker, the chef added a large spoonful of concentrated tomato paste.
cn: 厨师往锅里挖了一大勺番茄酱，好让面条的汤汁颜色更深、味道更浓。

t: n. 松露（食用真菌）；松露巧克力
en: These so-called truffle fries just taste like synthetic oil, totally not worth the extra ten bucks.
cn: 这所谓的松露薯条吃起来一股工业油味儿，根本不值加的那十块钱。
phr: black truffle 黑松露
truffle oil 松露油
chocolate truffle 松露巧克力

t: n. 芜菁；大头菜；萝卜（非植物学严格定义）
en: I tossed some diced turnip into the stew, hoping it would add a bit of sweetness.
cn: 我往炖菜里扔了点切好的大头菜，想让汤头喝起来更甜一点。
phr: turnip greens 芜菁叶
mashed turnips 芜菁泥

t: n. 伏特加酒
en: I drank too much vodka last night and now my head is spinning.
cn: 昨晚伏特加喝高了，现在我这脑袋还晕乎乎的转呢。
phr: a shot of vodka 一小杯伏特加
vodka martini 伏特加马天尼

t: n. 西洋菜；豆瓣菜
en: Just throw a bunch of watercress into the hotpot; it really cuts through the grease.
cn: 吃火锅觉得腻了就赶紧烫把西洋菜，那股清爽劲儿下去，胃里瞬间舒服多了。
tip: water(水) + cress(水芹) → 生长在水中的芹菜类植物 → 西洋菜，豆瓣菜
phr: watercress soup 西洋菜汤
fresh watercress 新鲜豆瓣菜

t: n. 白葡萄酒
en: I ordered white wine, but you brought red, and now my fish tastes all wrong.
cn: 我点了白葡萄酒，你却送来红的，这下鱼的味道全串了。

t: v. 挑出；剔出；（费力地）引出；n. 玉黍螺；食用海螺
en: It took me ten minutes to winkle the meat out of this shell with a toothpick.
cn: 我拿着牙签在那儿捅咕了十分钟，才好不容易把那点肉从螺壳里给挑出来。
tip: 熟词本义为玉黍螺 → 用针剔出螺肉 → 挑出；费力引出
phr: winkle out secrets 套出秘密
edible winkle 食用玉黍螺

t: n. 阿司匹林（解热镇痛药）
en: I need a giant aspirin and total silence to deal with this headache.
cn: 我现在需要一片超大号的阿司匹林，外加绝对的安静，不然我的头都要炸了。
phr: take an aspirin 服一片阿司匹林
baby aspirin 小剂量阿司匹林

t: 病历；个案史
en: The psychologist spent the entire afternoon reviewing the patient's detailed case history, looking for clues to understand their current struggles.
cn: 那个心理学家花了一整个下午看病人的详细个案史，想从里面找到线索，好明白他们现在为什么这么痛苦。

t: n. 感冒疗法；感冒药
en: I have tried every cold cure imaginable, but my nose is still blocked like cement.
cn: 试遍了各种感冒偏方，姜汤都灌了一肚子，鼻子还是堵得像塞了水泥。

t: adj. 糖尿病的；n. 糖尿病患者
en: Since my dad is diabetic, we made a sugar-free cake for his birthday.
cn: 因为我爸血糖高不能乱吃，过生日我们特意给他做了个无糖蛋糕。
tip: diabetes(糖尿病) + ic → 糖尿病的；患者
phr: diabetic diet 糖尿病饮食
type 2 diabetic 2型糖尿病患者

t: n. 滴眼剂；眼药水
en: My eyes are burning from staring at the screen all day, so I need to put in an eyedrop.
cn: 盯着屏幕看了一整天，我眼睛烧得难受，得滴点药水缓一缓。
tip: eye(眼睛) + drop(滴) → 滴进眼睛的水剂 → 眼药水
phr: apply eyedrops 滴眼药水
soothing eyedrop 舒缓眼药水

t: n. 退烧药；解热剂
en: He took a strong febrifuge and went straight to bed, hoping to break the fever by morning.
cn: 他吃了一剂强力退烧药就钻进被窝了，指望明儿一早醒来烧就能退下去。

t: 流鼻涕
en: I think I caught a cold while waiting for the bus in the rain, as I now have a runny nose and a headache.
cn: 我觉得八成是刚才淋雨等车冻感冒了，现在一直流鼻涕，头还沉得厉害。

t: n. 花粉热
en: My hay fever is acting up again, and I can't stop sneezing whenever I step outside into the garden.
cn: 我这花粉热又犯了，只要一进院子，喷嚏就打个没完，难受死了。

t: n. 眼科医生
en: I need to see an oculist because my vision has been getting blurry after staring at the computer all day.
cn: 我得去看眼科医生了，天天盯着电脑看，现在眼睛看啥都重影。
tip: ocul(眼睛) + ist(人) → 眼科医生
phr: consult an oculist 咨询眼科医生
prescribed by an oculist 由眼科医生开具

t: n. 药膏；软膏；油膏
en: Put some of this antibiotic ointment on that cut before it gets infected.
cn: 赶紧在伤口上涂点这消炎药膏吧，省得一会儿感染了。
tip: oint(oil油) + ment → 涂抹在皮肤表面的油润药膏 → 软膏，药膏
phr: apply an ointment 涂抹消炎软膏
antibiotic ointment 抗生素油膏
fly in the ointment 美中不足的败笔

t: n. 痰；粘液；冷淡；镇定
en: I've been coughing up phlegm all morning; I really shouldn't have come into the office today.
cn: 我咳了一早上的痰，今天真不该还要死要活地来办公室。
phr: cough up phlegm 咳出痰
remarkable phlegm 异乎寻常的沉着

t: 预防针
en: My mom kept nagging me to get a preventive injection before the flu season starts, as if I were still a five-year-old kid.
cn: 我妈一直叨叨着让我在流感季开始前去打个预防针，搞得我好像还是个五岁小孩一样。

t: n. 听诊器
en: The doctor pressed the cold stethoscope against my chest, making me shiver instantly.
cn: 医生把冰凉的听诊器贴在我胸口，冻得我瞬间打了个哆嗦。
tip: stetho(胸) + scope(看/观察器) → 听诊胸腔心跳的器械 → 听诊器
phr: listen with a stethoscope 用听诊器听诊
stethoscope around the neck 挂在脖上的听诊器

t: n. 糖浆；糖水
en: You put too much syrup on the pancakes; it's overly sweet.
cn: 松饼上倒这么多糖浆，你也不怕甜得腻死人。
phr: maple syrup 枫糖浆
cough syrup 止咳糖浆

t: adj. 扭曲的；变态的；邪恶的
en: That joke was really dark; you have a seriously twisted sense of humor.
cn: 那个笑话也太黑暗了，你的笑点真是够变态的。
tip: twist(扭曲) + ed → 扭曲变形的 → 扭曲的，变态的
phr: twisted mind 扭曲的心灵
twisted ankle 扭伤的脚踝
twisted sense of humor 变态的幽默感

t: n. 成绩单；学业档案
en: A singular bad grade on your academic record won't ruin your entire future.
cn: 档案里就这一门课考砸了，毁不了你的前途，别太焦虑。

t: n. 学年
en: By the end of the academic year, we were all exhausted and ready for summer.
cn: 这一学年熬到头，我们都累瘫了，就盼着暑假赶紧来。

t: n. 美术学院
en: She dreams of getting into the Academy of Fine Arts to paint all day.
cn: 她做梦都想考进美院，那样就能天天画画了。

t: phrase. 农学院
en: He surprised everyone by choosing an agricultural college over business school.
cn: 他放着好好的商学院不去，非要跑去农学院学种地，把家里七大姑八大姨都惊得下巴掉到了地上。

t: phrase. 农业大学
en: Researchers at the agricultural university developed a sweet corn variety.
cn: 农业大学那帮搞研究的捣鼓出一种新玉米，甜得让村里的老农们都尝得停不下来。

t: n. 副教授
en: Becoming an associate professor means you finally have some job security.
cn: 只要评上了副教授，这饭碗才算真正端稳了。

t: n. 附属中学（通常指依附于大学的中学）
en: Getting into the university's attached middle school is harder than getting into college.
cn: 想进这所大学的附中，那竞争激烈程度，比考大学还难。

t: n. 基础课；入门课程
en: Skip the advanced theory; you need the basic course to understand how the machine works.
cn: 别整那些高深理论，你得先上基础课才能搞懂这机器咋转。

t: n. 分校
en: The prestigious university is opening a branch school overseas to attract more international students.
cn: 那所名牌大学要在海外办分校，想多招点外国学生过来。

t: n. 课堂讨论
en: The teacher tried to spark a class discussion about climate change, but everyone was too tired to talk.
cn: 老师拼命想带大家聊聊气候变化，结果全班都打不起精神，场面一度很尴尬。

t: n. 进修班；高级研究班
en: He enrolled in a class for advanced studies to sharpen his coding skills and get a promotion at work.
cn: 他报了个高级进修班恶补编程，就盼着技术提升后能赶紧涨点工资、升个职。

t: 公共休息室
en: The students gathered in the common room after dinner to play cards and complain about teachers.
cn: 吃完晚饭，学生们全缩在休息室里，一边打牌一边吐槽老师。

t: n. 博学；全面的知识
en: He has comprehensive knowledge of European history, so you can ask him almost anything about the Middle Ages.

t: 必修课
en: I really wanted to skip the lecture, but since it's a compulsory course, I have to drag myself to class.
cn: 我真想翘了这节课，但谁让它是必修呢，只能硬着头皮去了。

t: n. 音乐学院
en: She practiced the piano for eight hours every day to prepare for her entrance exam at the conservatory of music.
cn: 她每天把自己关在琴房里练足八小时，就为了能考上那所顶尖的音乐学院。

t: 课程内容；课上教什么
en: Students are complaining that the actual content of courses doesn't match the descriptions in the brochure.
cn: 同学们都在吐槽，说课上讲的东西和当初宣传手册上写的完全是对不上号。

t: 函授学校
en: Many people choose a correspondence school because they need to balance work and study.
cn: 很多人选择上函授学校，就是想一边打工一边把学历给拿了。

t: 工程学院；工程研究所
en: He spent four years at a prestigious engineering institute, honing his skills in bridge design and construction.
cn: 他在那个顶尖的工学院苦读了四年，成天在那儿琢磨怎么盖桥，手艺练得相当扎实。

t: n. 应试教育
en: Many parents criticize exam-oriented education for putting too much pressure on children from a very young age.
cn: 很多家长都在吐槽应试教育，觉得这玩意儿让孩子从小就背着大山，活得太累了。

t: 交流经验
en: The veteran teachers gathered in the staffroom to exchange experience on how to handle difficult students.
cn: 资深老师们聚在办公室里，讨论交流该怎么管教那些不听话的学生。

t: 课外活动
en: Volunteering at the animal shelter is a meaningful extracurricular activity that teaches students responsibility.
cn: 去流浪狗收容所当义工挺有意义的，能让这帮孩子学会怎么负起责任来。

t: n. 假文凭；学历造假
en: He tried to get the job with a fake diploma, but the HR department verified his background.
cn: 他想拿假学历混进公司，结果背景调查时被HR一眼识破了。

t: n. 期末考试；最终测试
en: I stayed up all night for the final test but still felt like I knew nothing.
cn: 我为了期末考熬了大半夜，结果一进考场脑子里还是空空的。

t: 全职教师
en: The school hired a full-time teacher to replace the substitute who had been there for months.
cn: 学校正儿八经招了个老师，把之前那个带课好几个月的代课老师给换了。

t: 研究生
en: As a tired graduate student, he often finds himself drinking way too much coffee just to stay awake.
cn: 读研的日子真不是人过的，他天天为了让自己清醒点，咖啡一杯接一杯地灌。

t: 毕业通知；毕业喜报
en: I felt a sense of relief as I mailed out the last graduation announcement to my favorite high school teacher.
cn: 我把最后一份毕业喜报寄给高中老师后，整个人都松了一口气，总算交代清楚了。

t: 毕业鉴定；毕业考核
en: Your graduation appraisal depends not only on your final grades but also on your professor's recommendation.
cn: 你的毕业鉴定能不能过，除了看分数，还得看你导师最后怎么在评语里夸你。

t: 毕业典礼
en: Everyone was sweating in their heavy robes during the outdoor graduation ceremony on that hot July afternoon.
cn: 七月份的下午搞露天毕业礼，大家伙儿穿着厚重的学位服，汗流浃背地在那儿硬挺着。

t: 毕业实习；毕业野外考查
en: He spent two months doing his graduation field work in the mountains, collecting soil samples for his research.
cn: 他在山里猫了两个月搞毕业实习，天天在那儿挖土采样，整个人晒得黑了好几圈。

t: n. 客座讲师
en: The university invited a famous entrepreneur to be a guest lecturer and share his success story with the students.
cn: 学校请了个很有名的老板来当客座讲师，专门给学生们讲讲他是怎么从零开始把生意做大的。

t: 在职培训课程
en: I’m taking an in-service training course to brush up on my coding skills so I can stay competitive at work.
cn: 我最近在报班搞在职培训，打算把代码技术再精进一下，省得被后辈卷没了。

t: n. 课后辅导
en: I have to stay for instruction after class because I totally bombed the last math test and my parents are furious.
cn: 我得留下来接受课后辅导，因为上次数学考试我考得一塌糊涂，我爸妈气坏了。

t: 重点学校
en: Her parents pushed her to get into a key school, believing it was the only way to secure a future.
cn: 爸妈非逼着她考进那所重点中学，总觉得只要进了那道门，以后的日子就算有着落了。

t: 参考信；推荐信
en: The HR department asked for at least one letter of reference from my previous employer to verify my skills.
cn: 人事部要求我提供一封前雇主的参考信，以此来核实我的工作能力。

t: n. 扫盲班；识字班
en: My grandmother never had the chance to go to school as a child, so she’s now attending a literacy class.
cn: 我奶奶小时候没机会上学，现在倒好，快七十了还天天背着个小包去扫盲班认字。

t: n. 更衣室
en: The team celebrated their unexpected victory in the locker room by splashing water on their coach.
cn: 赢了那场意料之外的比赛后，队员们在更衣室里往教练身上泼水庆祝。

t: 医科大学
en: After graduating from the medical university, he spent years as an intern in one of the busiest city hospitals.
cn: 从医科大学毕业后，他在市里最忙的医院当了好几年实习生，累得够呛。

t: n. 走读生；非本地学生
en: As a non-resident student, he has to spend three hours commuting every day, which leaves him exhausted.
cn: 他是个走读生，每天光在上学路上就要耗掉三个钟头，整个人都快累瘫了。

t: n. 公开课；开放式课堂
en: Our history professor is holding an open class next week, and he told us to invite anyone who is interested in the topic of the Cold War.

t: n. 选修课
en: Since it’s an optional course, I don't feel too much pressure about the final exam results this semester.
cn: 反正是门选修课，这学期期末考成什么样我都不太往心里去，没啥压力。

t: 课外阅读
en: The teacher encouraged more outside reading to help students broaden their minds.
cn: 老师总劝大家多读点课外书，别整天只盯着教材看，得开阔下眼界。

t: n. 兼职教师
en: She works as a part-time teacher at the community center, helping adults learn basic but essential computer skills.
cn: 她在社区中心当兼职老师，专门教成年人一些很基础但又很必要的电脑操作。

t: adj. 以人为本的
en: My new boss claims to be very people-oriented, but he scheduled a team meeting at 7 PM on a Friday, so I'm not convinced.

t: n. 修业年限；读书期间
en: During his entire period of schooling, he never once handed in an assignment late.
cn: 在他整个读书上学期间，一次作业都没迟交过，真够自律的。

t: n. 体育学院
en: My cousin, who dreams of being an Olympic coach, is applying to every famous physical culture institute in the country, which makes my parents nervous.

t: n. 理工大学；工业大学
en: He chose a polytechnic university over a traditional one because he wanted more hands-on experience for his future engineering career.
cn: 他没选综合性大学，而是去了所理工大学，就是想多动动手，为以后干工程打好基础。

t: adj. 葡萄牙的；葡萄牙语的；n. 葡萄牙语；葡萄牙人
en: I tried speaking Portuguese to the waiter, but he just looked confused.
cn: 我试着跟服务员飙了两句葡萄牙语，结果人家一脸懵地看着我。
tip: Portugal(葡萄牙) + ese → 葡萄牙的；葡萄牙语
phr: speak Portuguese 讲葡萄牙语
Portuguese colonial rule 葡萄牙殖民统治

t: 职前教育
en: His pre-service education focused heavily on digital literacy, preparing him well for the modern tech workplace.
cn: 他的职前教育特别强调数字化能力，所以一进这种大厂，上手活儿来比谁都快。

t: n. 优质教育
en: Many parents are moving to this district because they believe the schools here provide a better quality education for their children.

t: phr. 接受教育
en: Every child deserves to receive education, but sadly, many in this region are forced to work instead of going to school.
cn: 每个孩子都该上学读书，但遗憾的是，这个地区的很多孩子被迫打工，根本没法去学校。

t: 登记表；注册表
en: Please fill out every section of the registration form or your application might be delayed.
cn: 登记表上每一项你都得填仔细了，落下一个字，你的申请可能就得被压在那儿。

t: n. 死记硬背
en: Rote learning might help you pass the exam, but you'll probably forget everything the moment you walk out.
cn: 死记硬背可能让你应付考试，但你估计一出考场就把东西全还给老师了。

t: n. 成绩单；学校报告
en: I'm dreading the moment my dad sees my school report because I failed math again.
cn: 我现在特别怕我爸看我成绩单，因为我数学这回又挂科了。

t: n. 课程表；作息时间表
en: Check the school timetable to see if we have any free periods on Friday afternoon.
cn: 看看课程表，看咱们周五下午有没有空出来的课。

t: n. 知识范围；见识
en: Reading widely across different genres can help you broaden your scope of knowledge significantly.
cn: 多读读各种类型的书，能帮你把见识扩充不少，不至于孤陋寡闻。

t: n. 自学考试
en: She got her degree through the self-taught examination system after years of hard work.
cn: 熬了好几年，她终于通过自考拿下了学位证，太不容易了。

t: n. 短期培训班
en: I signed up for a short-term training course to learn coding in a month.
cn: 我报了个短期速成班，想在一个月内把编程学会。

t: n. 专门课程；特设课程
en: I signed up for a special course on digital marketing to upgrade my skills.
cn: 我报了个数字营销的特训班，想把自己的技能再提升提升。

t: n. 专门课程
en: I signed up for a specialized course on coding but spent most of the time questioning my life choices.
cn: 我报了个编程特训班，结果大部分时间都在怀疑人生，不知当初为啥选这条路。

t: n. 员工休息室；教研室
en: The teachers usually hide in the staff room during recess just to get five minutes of peace.
cn: 课间的时候老师们通常都躲在休息室里，就为了图个五分钟的清净。

t: 学生会
en: The students' union bar is always packed on Friday nights after exams.
cn: 考完试的周五晚上，学生会酒吧总是挤得连下脚的地方都没有。

t: n. 教职员工
en: The principal called a meeting for all teaching and administrative staff.
cn: 校长通知所有上课的和坐班的行政都得去开大会，估计又要讲考勤的事。

t: n. 教研组；教学小组
en: Our teaching group meets on Fridays to plan next week's lessons.
cn: 我们教研组周五雷打不动要碰头，讨论下周怎么折磨学生。

t: n. 职业学校；技校
en: Not everyone fits in academia; trade schools are a great option for hands-on learners.
cn: 不是所有人都适合搞学术，对于爱动手的人来说，上个技校也是条好路子。

t: n. 会计助理
en: As an accounting assistant, my main job is chasing people for their receipts and organizing piles of invoices.
cn: 当个会计助理，我的主要工作就是追在人屁股后面要收据，还得整理成堆的发票。

t: adj. 机敏的；敏捷的；灵巧的
en: She is adroit at changing the subject whenever I ask about her ex-boyfriend.
cn: 每次我一问起她前任，她都能特别圆滑地把话题给岔开。
phr: adroit handling 巧妙的处理
adroit at negotiation 精于谈判

t: phr. 先进工作者
en: Being named an advanced worker got him a certificate, but sadly no raise in his paycheck.
cn: 被评为先进工作者也就是拿张奖状，可惜工资条上的数字是一点儿没涨。

t: adj. 友好的；和睦的；温和的（尤指在结束关系时）
en: They claimed their divorce was amicable, but I saw them arguing over who gets the coffee machine in the parking lot.
cn: 他俩嘴上说离婚离得挺体面，但我明明看见他在停车场为了争个咖啡机吵得面红耳赤。
tip: am(爱/友善) + ic + able → 友好的，和睦的
phr: amicable divorce 和平离婚
reach an amicable agreement 达成和解

t: adj. 指定的；约定的；装饰好的
en: We met at the appointed time, but the venue was closed for renovations.
cn: 我们按约定时间到了，结果发现那地方正在装修关门了。
tip: appoint(指定/约) + ed → 预先商定指定的 → 指定的；约定的
phr: at the appointed time 在约定时间
well-appointed room 设施完备的房间

t: adj. 忧虑的；担心的；恐惧的；善于领悟的
en: I felt apprehensive about checking my exam results, fearing I might have failed the math section.
cn: 我不太敢查成绩，心里直打鼓，生怕数学挂了。
tip: ap + prehend(抓) + ive → 心神被担忧紧紧抓住 → 忧虑的，担心的
phr: apprehensive about the future 对未来心存忧虑
apprehensive glance 担忧的眼神

t: 计算机工程师
en: My brother works as a computer engineer at a big tech firm, often spending his weekends fixing bugs.
cn: 我哥在大厂当码农，周末经常还得苦哈哈地修各种系统漏洞。

t: adj. 专注的；献身的；专用的
en: She is so dedicated to her job that she hasn't taken a vacation in three years.
cn: 她工作起来太拼了，整整三年连一天假都没休过。
tip: dedicate(奉献/专注) + ed → 全身心投入的 → 专注的；专用的
phr: dedicated to 致力于；专用于
dedicated server 专用服务器
dedicated staff 恪尽职守的员工

t: adj. 尽职的；顺从的；恭顺的
en: He makes a dutiful visit to his parents every Sunday, but he spends the whole time checking his watch.
cn: 他每周日都例行公事般去看父母，但坐在那儿的时候一直忍不住看表。
tip: duty(职责，孝道) + ful → 恪尽职守的；顺从恭顺的
phr: dutiful son 尽孝顺从的儿子
dutiful attendance 恪尽职守的出勤

t: adj. 节俭的；朴素的；花钱少的
en: Since losing his job, he has become surprisingly frugal and counts every penny he spends.
cn: 自从丢了工作，他变得特别抠门，花每一分钱都要算计半天。
phr: frugal lifestyle 节俭的生活方式
frugal meal 简朴的餐食

t: adj. 文雅的；有教养的；上流社会的；（旧时）假装斯文的
en: Despite being poor, she maintained a genteel manner that commanded respect.
cn: 别看她日子过得清贫，但那一举一动透着的优雅劲儿，真让人佩服。
tip: gent(gentle绅士) + eel → 保持绅士做派的 → 文雅的，上流的
phr: genteel manners 文雅得体的举止
genteel poverty 假装体面的贫困

t: adj. 公正的；不偏不倚的；中立的
en: As a referee, you have to stay impartial, even if the crowd is screaming at you.
cn: 做裁判就得把心摆正，哪怕全场观众都在嘘你，你也得不偏不倚地吹罚。
tip: im(不) + partial(偏袒的) → 不偏袒任何一方 → 公正的，中立的
phr: impartial advice 客观中立的建议
remain impartial 保持中立公正

t: n. 法律顾问
en: Our legal adviser told us not to sign the contract until we cleared up several confusing clauses.
cn: 我们的法律顾问叮嘱说，在那几条模糊的条款搞清楚之前，这合同千万不能签。

t: n. 营销主管；市场部高管
en: She worked her way up to become a marketing executive, managing a team of twenty creative designers and writers.
cn: 她一路拼命干到了主管的位置，现在带着二十来号搞创意和文案的小伙子。

t: n. 市场代表；销售代表
en: A marketing representative will visit your office tomorrow to demonstrate how our software can save your team time.
cn: 销售代表明天会去你们办公室，当面演示一下咱们这软件是怎么帮大家省功夫的。

t: v. 提名；任命；推荐（nominate的过去式和过去分词）
en: I was unluckily nominated to organize the office party that nobody wants to attend.
cn: 倒霉催的，我被推选去组织那场根本没人想参加的办公室聚会。

t: n. 职业道德
en: He copied my entire report and presented it as his own, which is a serious violation of professional ethic, and I'm still furious about it.
cn: 他把我的报告整个抄过去当成自己的汇报了，这严重违反了职业道德，我现在想起来还气得不行。

t: adj. 受过良好教育的；有教养的
en: Seeing him spit, I can't believe he is well-educated; it's shameful.
cn: 看他随地吐痰的样子，真不敢相信他是受过良好教育的人，太丢人了。

t: adj. 讨厌的；令人憎恶的；糟透的
en: The service at that restaurant was abominable; we waited an hour for water and the waiter rolled his eyes at us.
cn: 那家餐厅的服务简直烂透了，等杯水要一小时，服务员还冲我们翻白眼。
tip: ab(离) + omin(omen凶兆) + able → 视为凶兆避之不及 → 令人憎恶的
phr: abominable weather 恶劣透顶的天气
abominable crime 令人发指的罪行
Abominable Snowman 大雪怪

t: adv. 充满深情地；关爱地；亲切地
en: She affectionately calls her huge, scary-looking dog 'Tiny', rubbing his belly.
cn: 她一边揉着那只凶猛大狗的肚子，一边充满爱意地叫它‘小不点’。
tip: affection(深情) + ate + ly → 满含温柔与爱意地 → 充满深情地
phr: affectionately known as 被亲切地称作
smile affectionately 深情微笑
hug sb affectionately 充满爱意地拥抱

t: adj. 被逗乐的；觉得好笑的；顽皮的
en: He told the joke with such confidence, but I was not amused and just stared at him blankly.
cn: 他讲笑话时自信满满，但我完全笑不出来，就那么一脸漠然地瞪着他。
tip: amuse(逗乐) + d → 被逗乐的，觉得好笑的
phr: amused smile 会心的微笑
be amused by 被……逗乐

t: adj. 冷漠的；无动于衷的；缺乏兴趣的
en: The students were so apathetic that the teacher started dancing to get attention.
cn: 学生们一个个反应冷淡，老师为了博关注都开始跳舞了。
tip: a(无) + path(感情) + etic → 没有感情波动的 → 冷漠的
phr: apathetic attitude 冷漠的态度
politically apathetic 对政治漠不关心的

t: adj. 吃惊的；惊讶的；v. 使吃惊（astonish的过去式和过去分词）
en: I was astonished that he actually apologized; usually he just blames everyone else.
cn: 他居然道歉了，真让我大吃一惊，平时他只会到处甩锅。

t: adj. 震惊的；目瞪口呆的
en: I was astounded by how quickly he managed to lose his phone again.
cn: 他又把手机弄丢了，这速度快得让我目瞪口呆。
tip: a + stound(astonish震惊) + ed → 目瞪口呆的
phr: astounded by 对……感到震惊
look astounded 面露震惊
astounded to discover 震惊地发现

t: adj. 困惑的；不知所措的；晕头转向的
en: She stared at the assembly instructions, completely bewildered by where the screw should go.
cn: 她盯着那张复杂的组装说明书，完全搞不懂这颗螺丝到底该往哪儿拧。
tip: be(使) + wild(荒野) + ered → 迷失在荒野找不到路 → 困惑迷茫的
phr: bewildered look 茫然困惑的神色
utterly bewildered 感到万分不知所措

t: adj. 精神抖擞的；活跃的
en: The old man felt quite bobbish after his morning walk and was ready to tackle the garden chores.
cn: 晨练回来后老头儿精神头十足，挽起袖子就准备去院子里除草干活了。

t: adj. 着迷的；有魔力的
en: He charmed everyone at the party with his funny stories and smile.
cn: 他靠着那堆段子和笑脸，把聚会上的人都哄得服服帖帖的。
tip: charm(魔法；魅力) + ed → 被施了魔法的 → 着迷的
phr: lead a charmed life 人生顺遂
charmed by her grace 被其优雅倾倒

t: adv. 郁郁寡欢地；极其忧伤地
en: He sat disconsolately on the bench after hearing the bad news.
cn: 听完那个糟糕的消息后，他一个人在那儿垂头丧气地坐着，看起来魂儿都没了。
tip: dis(无) + console(安慰) + ately → 得不到任何慰藉地 → 郁郁寡欢地
phr: weep disconsolately 伤心欲绝地哭泣
wander disconsolately 郁郁寡欢地漫步

t: adj. 厌恶的；反感的；气愤的
en: She looked absolutely disgusted when I dipped my french fries into her strawberry milkshake.
cn: 我拿薯条蘸她的草莓奶昔吃，她看我的眼神简直像吞了只苍蝇。
tip: disgust(使厌恶) + ed → 感到反感的，厌恶的
phr: deeply disgusted 深恶痛绝
disgusted with the behavior 对该行径反感

t: adj. 忧伤的；悲痛的
en: The cello played a dolorous melody that perfectly matched the rainy, lonely atmosphere of the empty seaside resort.
cn: 大提琴拉出的曲子听着特别致郁，跟这雨天冷清的海边简直绝配。
tip: dol(condolence哀悼) + orous → 沉浸在哀痛之中的 → 悲痛忧伤的
phr: dolorous cry 悲恸号哭
dolorous tone 凄切哀怨的语调

t: adj. 狂喜的；入迷的；欣喜若狂的
en: She was ecstatic when she finally got tickets to the concert after waiting in line for hours.
cn: 排了好几个小时队终于抢到演唱会门票，她高兴得差点跳起来。
tip: ec(ex出) + sta(stand站) + tic → 喜极出窍站立不稳 → 狂喜的
phr: ecstatic crowd 狂喜的人群
in an ecstatic state 处于极度狂喜中

t: adj. 兴高采烈的；欣喜若狂的
en: Hearing the boss is traveling next week, the whole office was so elated we wanted to pop champagne.
cn: 听说老板下周要去出差，整个办公室的人都elated得想开香槟庆祝。
tip: 形似 elevate(高举) → 情绪被高高托起 → 兴高采烈的，欣喜若狂的
phr: feel elated 感到兴高采烈
elated by the news 闻讯欣喜若狂

t: adj. 被迷住的；被吸引住的
en: The kids were completely enthralled by the magician, forgetting to eat their ice cream.
cn: 孩子们被魔术师迷得神魂颠倒，连手里的冰淇淋化了都忘了吃。
phr: enthralled audience 沉醉其中的观众
be enthralled by 深受…吸引

t: adj. 激怒的；恼火的；极不耐烦的
en: He gave an exasperated sigh when I asked him to explain the instructions for the third time.
cn: 我让他把说明书再讲第三遍时，他极不耐烦地叹了口气，脸都黑了。
phr: exasperated sigh 恼火的叹息
grow exasperated with 对…极不耐烦

t: adj. 受宠若惊的；感到荣幸的
en: He actually asked for my number at the bar; I was so flattered I couldn't stop smiling.
cn: 他居然在酒吧找我要电话，我简直受宠若惊，嘴角根本压不下来。
tip: flatter(奉承) + ed → 被夸赞后心生自豪 → 受宠若惊的
phr: feel deeply flattered 深感荣幸
be flattered by the praise 因受称赞而受宠若惊

t: adj. 慌张的；激动的；不知所措的
en: He got so flustered during the presentation that he forgot his own name.
cn: 他演讲时慌得一塌糊涂，紧张到脑子一片空白，连自己叫啥都忘了。
phr: get flustered easily 容易慌张
look visibly flustered 显得明显慌乱

t: adj. 筋疲力尽的
en: Forwearied from the endless arguments with my family, I locked myself in my room, craving just a moment of peace.

t: adj. 满意的；欣慰的
en: I was gratified to see that my ex-boyfriend got fat and bald.
cn: 看到前男友现在又秃又胖，我心里别提多爽了。
tip: grati(grateful感激/高兴) + fied → 心生欢喜的 → 满意的，欣慰的
phr: deeply gratified 深感欣慰
gratified smile 满意的微笑

t: adj. 恼火的；不耐烦的；受刺激的
en: She was visibly irritated when the waiter got her order wrong.
cn: 服务员把菜上错了，她那脸唰地一下就拉下来了，满脸不高兴。
tip: irritate(激怒) + ed → 感到恼火的；受刺激的
phr: become irritated 变得恼火
irritated by the noise 被噪音惹恼
soothe irritated skin 舒缓受刺激皮肤

t: adj. 无拘无束的；被解放的
en: Walking out of the office on Friday evening, I felt completely liberated from the week's stress.
cn: 周五晚上走出办公室那一刻，我感觉整个人都从工作的重压里解脱了。
tip: liber(自由) + ated → 从束缚中解脱获得自由的 → 被解放的
phr: feel liberated 感到身心解脱
liberated mindset 思想解放的心态

t: adj. 欣喜若狂的；万分高兴的
en: When she saw the acceptance letter, she was so overjoyed that she tackled me with a hug.
cn: 看到录取通知书的那一刻，她乐疯了，猛地扑过来给了我一个熊抱。
tip: over(过度) + joy(喜悦) + ed → 喜悦超出寻常 → 欣喜若狂的
phr: be overjoyed at 对…欣喜若狂
overjoyed to hear 听到…万分高兴

t: adj. 不知所措的
en: She was overwhelmed by the emails piling up after her vacation and wanted to cry.
cn: 休假回来看到堆积如山的邮件，她整个人都懵了，急得想哭。
tip: over(过度) + whelm(淹没) + ed → 彻底被淹没压垮 → 不知所措的
phr: feel overwhelmed 感到不知所措/难以招架
overwhelmed with gratitude 感激万分

t: adj. 困惑的；茫然的；搞不清楚的
en: I was puzzled by his strange instructions.
cn: 听完老板那通云山雾绕的讲话，我们几个面面相觑，完全搞不懂他到底想要什么。
tip: puzzle(谜题) + ed → 像掉进谜团中 → 困惑的，茫然的
phr: puzzled look 困惑的神情
puzzled by 对……感到不解

t: adj. 精神焕发的；返老还童的
en: After ten hours of sleep, I felt totally rejuvenated and ready to work.
cn: 睡足了十个小时后，我感觉整个人都活过来了，干劲十足。
tip: re(重新) + juven(juvenile青年) + ated → 再次年轻 → 精神焕发的
phr: feel completely rejuvenated 感觉彻底焕发活力
rejuvenated neighborhood 重获生机的街区

t: adj. 感到宽慰的；放心的；释然的
en: I was so relieved to hear that I passed the exam, I almost cried.
cn: 听到考试过了那一刻，我心里的石头总算落地了，差点没哭出来。
tip: relieve(缓解/解脱) + d → 负担卸下心头一松 → 感到宽慰的，释然的
phr: feel relieved 感到宽慰
relieved smile 宽慰的微笑

t: adj. 像鼻烟的；易怒的；不爽的
en: The old man got a bit snuffy when I asked him to move his chair.
cn: 我让那老头挪下椅子，他立马就一脸不高兴，气哼哼的。
tip: snuff(鼻烟) + y → 像鼻烟的；抽鼻涕生闷气的 → 易怒的
phr: snuffy old man 易怒的小老头
smell snuffy 带有鼻烟味

t: adv. 戏弄地；揶揄地
en: She smilingly and teasingly held the candy just out of the child's reach.
cn: 她笑着故意逗那个孩子，把糖举得高高的，让他怎么也够不着。
tip: tease(戏弄) + ingly → 戏弄地；打趣地
phr: smile teasingly 戏谑地微笑
say teasingly 打趣揶揄地说道

t: adj. 恐惧的；受惊吓的
en: She was absolutely terrified when the power went out during the horror movie.
cn: 看恐怖片正到高潮突然停电，她吓得尖叫一声，差点钻到沙发底下去。
tip: terr(恐吓) + ify + ed → 极度受到惊吓的 → 恐惧的
phr: terrified of the dark 惧怕黑暗
look terrified 面露惊恐

t: adj. 极度兴奋的；非常激动的；震颤的
en: I was absolutely thrilled when they told me I got the job offer.
cn: 听到他们说录用我的时候，我简直激动得都要跳起来了。
tip: thrill(震颤/激动) + ed → 极度激动的
phr: thrilled to bits 兴奋不已
thrilled at the news 对消息感到激动

t: adj. 受感动的；精神失常的（俚语）
en: I was really touched that he remembered my birthday after all this time.
cn: 真没想到隔了这么久他还记得我生日，当时我心里确实挺感动的。
tip: touch(触碰/触动) + ed → 心灵被触及的 → 受感动的
phr: deeply touched 深受感动
touched by kindness 为善举所触动
a bit touched 脑袋有点不灵光的

t: adj. 不知疲倦的；不厌其烦的
en: He was unwearied in his efforts to fix the bug, working through the night.
cn: 他为了修那个bug简直不知疲倦，熬了个通宵都没停手。

t: 信不信由你
en: Believe it or not, I actually finished that massive project in just three days without any help.
cn: 说出来你可能不信，我硬是没靠任何人，花三天就把那个大项目给搞定了。

t: 根据定义；本质上
en: Being a parent is exhausting by definition, so don't feel bad if you just want to sleep all weekend.
cn: 当父母这事儿本身就累人，所以你要是只想睡个周末，千万别觉得愧疚。

t: 考虑到；鉴于
en: She did quite well on the test, considering that she had only two days to study.
cn: 考虑到她满打满算也就复习了两天，这成绩已经算考得相当不错了。

t: 在这之后
en: Following this announcement, the stock price plummeted as investors began to lose confidence in the company.
cn: 这条消息一出来，投资人对公司都没信心了，股价跟着就跌得不成样子。

t: 既然；考虑到
en: Given that he has no prior experience in marketing, he did a surprisingly good job on the latest campaign.
cn: 考虑到他压根儿没搞过营销，这次活动能办成这样，确实已经挺让人刮目相看了。

t: phr. 如果有必要
en: I can stay late and finish the report tonight if necessary, just let me know.
cn: 只要有需要，我今晚可以留下来加个班把报告赶出来，你言语一声就行。

t: phr. 如果可能的话
en: I'd like to reschedule our meeting to Friday afternoon if possible, as my morning is completely booked.
cn: 如果方便的话，咱们把会挪到周五下午吧，我上午已经忙得脚不沾地了。

t: phrase. 无论如何；不管怎样
en: It might rain or snow, but in any event, I'll be there waiting for you.
cn: 不管到时候下不下雨，反正我肯定会准时到，你就在门口等我好了。

t: 简言之；总之；简单地说
en: In brief, the project is over budget and we need to cut costs immediately.
cn: 简单说就是项目超支了，我们现在必须马上勒紧裤腰带省钱。

t: conj. 为了；以便
en: I work two jobs in order that my children can have a better education than I did.
cn: 我拼了命打两份工，就是为了让孩子们能读好书，别像我这么辛苦。

t: phr. 实际上；事实上
en: He looks rich on Instagram, but in reality, he's living in a basement.
cn: 他在网上看着光鲜亮丽，其实背地里穷得只能住地下室。

t: prep. 鉴于；考虑到；由于
en: In view of his recent poor performance, we decided to give the project to someone else.
cn: 看着他最近表现这么差劲，我们决定把这个项目转手交给别人去做。

t: phr. 由于；因为；为了……的缘故
en: The flight was delayed on account of the storm, so I'm stuck at the airport.
cn: 因为暴风雨航班延误了，我现在只能被困在机场里。

t: adv. 起初；原来；独创地
en: I originally planned to save money, but then the steam sale happened.
cn: 我本来打算攒点钱的，结果Steam一开始打折，我就管不住手了。
tip: origin(起源) + ally → 从根源上看 → 起初，原本
phr: originally planned 原定计划
come originally from 最初来自

t: conj. 鉴于；由于；既然
en: Seeing that nobody is prepared for the meeting, I suggest we reschedule it to next Monday.
cn: 既然大家都没准备好，我看这会还是改到下周一再开吧。

t: 说实话；讲真话
en: I know it will hurt, but I have to tell the truth about that night.
cn: 虽然这话说出来挺伤人的，但我必须得把那天晚上的真相告诉你。

t: adv. 不可否认地；确凿地；无可争辩地
en: The food was expensive, but the view from the rooftop was undeniably spectacular.
cn: 菜确实贵了点，但屋顶这景色确实美得没话说。
tip: un(不) + deni(deny否认) + ably → 无法否认地 → 不可否认地
phr: undeniably true 确凿无疑
undeniably prove 无可辩驳地证明

t: prep. 意在；为了；着眼于
en: He's been working overtime every weekend with a view to getting that promotion before the year ends.
cn: 他每个周末都在加班，就是冲着年底前能升职去的。

t: 毫无保留地；完全地
en: I can recommend this restaurant without reservation because the food is incredible and the service is top-notch.
cn: 我敢打包票推荐这家餐厅，菜做得绝了，服务也特别到位，保你满意。

t: phrase. 更糟的是
en: I forgot my umbrella this morning, and worse still, I left my house keys on the kitchen counter.
cn: 我早起忘了带伞，结果更倒霉的是，我把房门钥匙也落厨房台子上了。

t: n. 大修道院；寺院
en: We visited an ancient abbey where monks used to brew their own beer centuries ago.
cn: 我们去逛了个古老的修道院，几百年前那些僧侣就在那儿自己酿啤酒。
tip: 来自 abbot(修道院院长) 的居所 → 大修道院，寺院
phr: Westminster Abbey 威斯敏斯特大教堂
ruins of the abbey 修道院遗址

t: n. 字母表；基础知识；（美籍华人）American-Born Chinese
en: He looks local, but as soon as he speaks, you can tell he's a total ABC.
cn: 他长得像本地人，可一开口你就能听出来，是个典型的香蕉人。
tip: A+B+C(前三字母) → 字母表；基础知识
phr: the ABCs of ...的基础
as easy as ABC 极其容易

conf.def: 美国经典电影有线电视台

t: adj. 土著的；原住民的；原始的；n. 土著居民
en: We saw some ancient Aboriginal rock art in the cave; it felt like stepping back in time.
cn: 我们在洞穴里看到了一些古老的 Aboriginal 岩画，感觉就像瞬间穿越回了远古时代。
tip: ab(从) + origin(起源) + al → 自始就在本土生活的 → 原住民的
phr: Aboriginal art 澳洲土著艺术
Aboriginal inhabitant 土著居民

t: adv. 突然地；唐突地；意外地
en: The meeting ended abruptly when the fire alarm went off.
cn: 火警一响，会开到一半就戛然而止，大家全都懵着往外跑。
tip: ab(离) + rupt(断) + ly → 骤然折断开来地 → 突然地，唐突地
phr: stop abruptly 戛然而止
leave abruptly 拂袖而去

t: adj. 心不在焉的；健忘的
en: I was so absent-minded this morning that I put the milk in the cupboard and the keys in the fridge.
cn: 我早上太迷糊了，顺手把牛奶塞进橱柜，却把钥匙扔进了冰箱。

t: v. 宣告……无罪；赦免；免除（责任、义务等）
en: You can't just absolve yourself of responsibility by saying you didn't know the deadline changed.
cn: 你不能光嘴上一句不知道截止日期变了，就把自己的责任撇得一干二净。
tip: ab(离去/免除) + solve(解开) → 解开罪责束缚 → 赦免，免除责任
phr: absolve someone of guilt 宣告某人无罪
absolve from all responsibility 免除一切责任

t: n. 伴奏；伴随物；佐餐食品
en: A dry martini is the perfect accompaniment to a long rant about your terrible boss.
cn: 当你吐槽那极品老板的时候，配上一杯干马提尼简直绝了。
tip: accompany(伴随) + ment → 伴随主体的乐音或配菜 → 伴奏；佐餐食品
phr: piano accompaniment 钢琴伴奏
ideal accompaniment 绝佳的配菜搭配
to the accompaniment of 在…伴随下

t: adj. 才华高的；有造诣的；熟练的
en: Finally cleaning up this messy room makes me feel surprisingly accomplished.
cn: 把这狗窝一样的房间收拾干净后，我竟然觉得自己还挺能干的。
tip: ac + compl(complete完成) + ed → 功成名就的 → 有造诣的；熟练的
phr: accomplished musician 杰出的音乐家
accomplished fact 既成事实

t: n. 首字母缩略词
en: The boss used so many acronyms in the meeting that I needed a decoder ring.
cn: 老板开会用了一堆缩写词，我不拿个解码器根本听不懂他在说什么。

t: adv. 公元 (Anno Domini)
en: The castle was built in 1200 A.D. and somehow is still standing.
cn: 这座城堡建于公元1200年，居然直到现在还没塌。

t: n. 适配器；转接插头；改编者
en: I realized I forgot to pack a power adaptor, so now I can't charge my laptop in this foreign hotel.
cn: 我才发现忘带电源转接头了，现在在这外国酒店里，电脑充不了电，真是急死我了。
tip: adapt(使适应) + or(物) → 使匹配的工具 → 适配器
phr: power adaptor 电源适配器
travel adaptor 旅行转换插头

t: adv. 此外；另外；加之
en: You need to finish the report by five, and additionally, the boss wants you to organize the filing cabinet before you leave.
cn: 你得在五点前搞定报告，不仅如此，老板还让你走之前把档案柜理好。
tip: addition(附加) + al + ly → 额外补充地 → 此外；另外
phr: additionally required 额外要求的
additionally provide 另外提供

t: n. 海军上将；舰队司令
en: He shouted orders like an admiral on a sinking ship, but nobody was listening.
cn: 他像沉船上的海军上将一样大吼大叫乱发号令，可惜根本没人听他的。
tip: admir(admire敬佩) + al → 令人敬佩的军中统帅 → 海军上将
phr: rear admiral 海军少将
admiral's flagship 上将旗舰

t: n. 冒险主义
en: Critics warned that the general’s plan was pure adventurism and would likely lead the country into a messy war.
cn: 批评家们警告说，那位将军的计划纯属军事冒险，搞不好会把国家拖进战争泥潭。
tip: adventure(冒险) + ism(主义) → 盲动行事 → 冒险主义
phr: military adventurism 军事冒险主义
warn against adventurism 告诫切勿盲动冒险

t: n. 冒险主义者；投机分子；adj. 冒险主义的
en: His adventurist policies scared away all the investors, leaving the company in trouble.
cn: 他那套激进的冒险主义政策把投资人都吓跑了，谁敢陪他疯啊。

t: adj. 副词的；状语的；n. 状语
en: You piled up too many adverbial phrases, making it hard to read.
cn: 你这一段状语堆得太多，读起来气都喘不匀，句子太累赘了。
tip: adverb(副词) + ial(形缀) → 副词特征的 → 副词的；状语
phr: adverbial clause 状语从句
serve an adverbial function 起状语修饰作用

t: n. 后效；余波；副作用
en: The aftereffect of last night's drinking is a splitting headache.
cn: 昨晚喝得太猛，现在的后劲儿就是头疼欲裂，以后真不敢了。
tip: after(在…后) + effect(效果) → 事后产生的效果 → 后效，副作用
phr: lingering aftereffects 挥之不去的后效
aftereffects of the earthquake 地震引发的余波

t: n. 侵略者；攻击者；挑衅者
en: In the schoolyard fight, it was hard to tell who was the victim and who was the aggressor.
cn: 校园斗殴里一片混乱，根本分不清谁是受害者，谁是挑事儿的。
tip: ag(去) + gress(走，迈步) + or(人) → 主动跨步挑衅入侵的人 → 侵略者
phr: repel the aggressor 击退侵略者
unprovoked aggressor 无端挑衅的侵略者

t: adj. 漫无目的的；没有目标的；盲目的
en: After quitting my job, I spent an aimless summer walking around the city and feeding pigeons.
cn: 辞职以后，我过了个没着没落的夏天，整天就在城里瞎晃悠喂鸽子。
tip: aim(目标) + less(无) → 没有明确方向的 → 漫无目的的
phr: aimless wander 漫无目的的游荡
feel aimless 感到迷茫无目标

t: n. 空军基地
en: Living near the airbase means you get used to the sound of jets shaking your windows.
cn: 住在空军基地旁边，你就得习惯喷气式飞机把窗户震得嗡嗡响。
tip: air(空中) + base(基地) → 空军基地
phr: military airbase 军用空军基地
stationed at an airbase 驻扎在空军基地

t: adj. 装有空调的
en: It's roasting outside, so let's duck into an air-conditioned shop to cool down.
cn: 外面这大太阳能把人烤化了，赶紧找个有空调的地方躲一躲凉快一下。

t: n. 飞机场；起落场（尤指军用或小型）
en: We met at a deserted airfield to test the new drone.
cn: 我们约在一个废弃的小机场碰头，专门去那儿试飞新的无人机。
tip: air(空中) + field(场地) → 飞机起落的场地 → 飞机场
phr: military airfield 军用机场
land at an airfield 降落在简易机场

t: n. 空中小姐；女乘务员
en: The airhostess gently woke me up to ask if I wanted breakfast before we landed.
cn: 空姐轻轻把我叫醒，问我落地前要不要先吃点早餐。
tip: air(空中) + hostess(女主人/招待) → 空中小姐
phr: trainee airhostess 实习空姐
chief airhostess 乘务长

t: n. 大型客机；班机
en: A massive airliner flew directly overhead, shaking the windows of our apartment building.
cn: 一架巨型客机正好从头顶飞过，震得我们要寓的窗户都在哗哗响。
tip: air(空中) + liner(定期客班) → 空中客运班机 → 大型客机
phr: commercial airliner 商业民航客机
board the airliner 登上客机

t: adj. & adv. 按菜单点菜的（地）；仅点单品的
en: The set menu was full of things we hate, so we went à la carte and picked exactly what we wanted.
cn: 套餐里全是些不爱吃的，我们索性就单点了几样自己喜欢的，虽然贵点但吃得舒心。

t: int. 唉；哎呀（表示悲伤、遗憾或忧虑）
en: I planned to start my diet today, but alas, someone brought donuts to the office.
cn: 我本打算今天开始节食，哎呀可惜，有人带了甜甜圈来办公室。

t: n. 藻类；海藻
en: I need to clean the fish tank; green alga is covering the glass and I can barely see the fish.
cn: 我得刷鱼缸了，玻璃上长满了绿藻，连鱼都快看不清了。
phr: blue-green alga 蓝藻
single-celled alga 单细胞藻类

t: n. 短吻鳄
en: We spotted an alligator near the swamp during our hike, and it scared the living daylights out of us.
cn: 徒步的时候我们在沼泽边撞见一条短吻鳄，差点把我们要吓死。
phr: alligator leather 鳄鱼皮
alligator clip 鳄鱼夹
wrestle an alligator 与鳄鱼搏斗

t: adj. 冷漠的；疏远的；超然的
en: He acts aloof, but honestly, I think he's just shy.
cn: 他看着挺高冷，但我真心觉得他就是害羞不敢说话。
phr: keep aloof from 置身事外远离
aloof manner 冷若冰霜的神情

t: n. 女校友；女毕业生
en: She is a famous alumna who donates a lot of money to the school every year.
cn: 她可是咱学校挺有名的女校友，回回校庆都要捐一大笔钱。
tip: alumn(alumnus校友) + a(阴性词尾) → 毕业的女学生 → 女校友
phr: distinguished alumna 杰出女校友
alumna of the university 该大学的女毕业生

t: adj. 顺从的；通情达理的；经得起...检验的；对...负有责任的
en: Surprisingly, my dad was amenable to the trip, even though it costs a fortune.
cn: 没想到我爸竟然同意了这次旅行，哪怕花销这么大，他也没说什么。
phr: amenable to reason 通情达理
amenable to change 顺应变革

t: adj. 有毛病的；出差错的；adv. 错误地；不顺心地
en: I noticed something amiss when the dog didn't bark at the postman like he usually does.
cn: 平时邮递员一来狗就叫，今天却没动静，我顿时觉得不对劲。
tip: a + miss(错过，失误) → 出了差错 → 出差错的，有毛病的
phr: something is amiss 某事出了差错
take something amiss 对某事感到介意
would not come amiss 正合时宜

t: n. 安培计；电流表
en: The needle on the ammeter didn't move at all, so the circuit must be broken.
cn: 安培计上的指针动都不动，我看这电路肯定是哪里断了。
tip: am(ampere安培) + meter(仪表) → 测量安培的仪器 → 安培计，电流表
phr: digital ammeter 数字电流表
connect an ammeter 接入电流表

t: n. 氨；氨水
en: The smell of ammonia in the cat litter box nearly knocked me out.
cn: 猫砂盆里那股氨水味直冲脑门，熏得我差点没背过气去。
phr: liquid ammonia 液氨
pungent smell of ammonia 刺鼻氨味

t: n. [电] 安培（电流单位）
en: Check the fuse rating; if you put a 5-ampere one in a 13-ampere slot, it will blow immediately.
cn: 检查下保险丝的安培数，要是把5安的装到13安的槽里，通电立马就烧。
tip: 法国物理学家安培(Ampère)之名 → 安培（电流单位）
phr: ampere rating 额定安培数
measure in amperes 以安培为单位计量

t: n. 放大器；扩音器；扬声器
en: We blew the amplifier during rehearsal because the drummer insisted we weren't playing loud enough.
cn: 排练的时候我们把音箱给干爆了，就因为鼓手非说我们弹得不够大声。
tip: amplify(放大) + er(物) → 放大声音的设备 → 扩音器
phr: guitar amplifier 吉他扩音器
power amplifier 功率放大器

t: n. （广播或电视节目的）男主播；（接力赛的）末棒运动员
en: The anchorman struggled to keep a straight face while reading the bizarre news story.
cn: 播那条奇葩新闻的时候，那个男主播憋笑憋得脸都僵了。
tip: anchor(锚；顶梁柱) + man → 节目的定海神针 → 男主播
phr: news anchorman 新闻男主播
veteran anchorman 资深男主播

t: n. 女新闻主播；女节目主持人
en: The anchorwoman managed to stay calm even as the studio lights suddenly went out.
cn: 演播室灯光突然灭了，但那个女主播还是特淡定，接着播新闻。
tip: anchor(主播/支柱) + woman(女性) → 挑大梁的主持 → 女新闻主播
phr: act as anchorwoman 担任新闻女主播
prime-time anchorwoman 黄金档女主播

t: adv. 愤怒地；气冲冲地
en: She slammed the door angrily and stormed out of the room.
cn: 她气呼呼地摔门而去，留下一屋子人面面相觑，谁也不敢说话。
tip: angry(愤怒的) + ly(副词后缀) → 愤怒地，气冲冲地
phr: stare angrily 怒目而视
reply angrily 愤怒地答复
storm out angrily 气冲冲地冲出去

t: n. 编年史；年鉴；历史记载
en: That party will go down in the annals of our college history as the night the police arrived three separate times.
cn: 那场派对绝对能载入咱们的校史，毕竟警察一晚上来了三回，这场面谁见过。
tip: ann(年) + als(名词后缀) → 按年份编排的记载 → 编年史，年鉴
phr: in the annals of history 载入史册
annals of medicine 医学年鉴

t: n. 阳极；正极
en: Current flows from the cathode to the anode inside the device.
cn: 在这个装置内部，电流是从阴极流向阳极的。
tip: an(向上/入) + ode(通路) → 电流流入的电极通道 → 阳极，正极
phr: anode and cathode 阳极与阴极
sacrificial anode 牺牲阳极

t: n. 国歌；颂歌；赞美诗
en: The crowd stood in silence as the national anthem played before the game.
cn: 比赛开始前国歌一响，全场观众立马起立，一片肃静。
phr: national anthem 国歌
rock anthem 摇滚代表作
sing an anthem 高唱颂歌

t: n. 滑稽动作；古怪姿态；adj. 古怪的
en: The children's wild antics at the restaurant were embarrassing everyone at the table.
cn: 孩子们在餐厅里疯疯癫癫地上蹿下跳，搞得我们一桌人都尴尬死了。
phr: childish antics 孩子气滑稽举止
grow tired of someone's antics 厌倦某人的胡闹

t: adv. 焦虑地；不安地；渴望地
en: We sat in the hallway, anxiously waiting for the doctor to come out with news.
cn: 我们坐在走廊里，提心吊胆地等着医生出来告诉我们结果。
tip: anxious(焦虑的) + ly → 焦虑地，不安地
phr: wait anxiously 焦急地等待
anxiously anticipated 万分期待的

t: n. 撇号（'）；省略符号；（修辞）呼语
en: My teacher circled every missing apostrophe in red ink, destroying my confidence.
cn: 老师用红笔圈出了每一个漏写的撇号，把我的自信心打击得稀碎。
phr: insert an apostrophe 加撇号
possessive apostrophe 所有格撇号

t: n. 被任命者；被指定人
en: The new political appointee has zero experience in this field, which is making all the veteran staff very angry.
cn: 那个新任命的官员在这个领域毫无经验，搞得老员工们都一肚子火。
tip: appoint(任命) + ee(受动者后缀) → 被选派任命的人 → 被任命者
phr: political appointee 政治任命官员
new appointee 新上任者

t: n. 杏；杏子；杏黄色
en: I painted the nursery walls a soft apricot color to make the room feel warmer.
cn: 我把婴儿房的墙刷成了柔和的杏黄色，想让屋里看着暖和点。
phr: apricot jam 杏子酱
apricot blossom 杏花

t: n. 阿拉伯半岛
en: Movies always show Arabia as endless sand dunes, but the cities there are actually super modern.
cn: 电影老把阿拉伯半岛拍成无尽的沙丘，其实那儿的城市现代化得不行。
phr: Saudi Arabia 沙特阿拉伯
peninsula of Arabia 阿拉伯半岛

t: adj. 阿拉伯的；阿拉伯人的；n. 阿拉伯人
en: This shop claims to serve authentic Arabian coffee, but it tastes instant.
cn: 这家店号称卖的是正宗阿拉伯咖啡，我喝着怎么像速溶的，又被坑了。
tip: Arab(阿拉伯) + ian → 阿拉伯的；阿拉伯人
phr: Arabian Nights 《一千零一夜》
Arabian horse 阿拉伯马
Arabian Peninsula 阿拉伯半岛

t: n. 大主教；总主教
en: The archbishop walked in with a hat so tall I wondered if he had to duck through doorways.
cn: 大主教戴着顶特高的帽子走了进来，我都怀疑他进门时是不是得低着头才行。
tip: arch(大/总) + bishop(主教) → 地位最高的主教 → 大主教
phr: Archbishop of Canterbury 坎特伯雷大主教
ordain an archbishop 祝圣大主教

t: n. 拱门；拱道
en: We took shelter under the old archway, watching the rain pour down in silence.
cn: 我们躲在那座古老的拱门下避雨，看着雨滴落下，气氛突然变得很浪漫。
tip: arch(拱形) + way(路) → 拱形通道 → 拱门，拱道
phr: stone archway 石质拱门
pass through an archway 穿过拱道

t: n. 腋窝；最脏乱的地方（喻）
en: This cheap motel is the armpit of the city, dirty and smelling awful.
cn: 这家廉价旅馆简直是这城市的腋窝，又脏又臭让人想吐。
tip: arm(手臂) + pit(深凹坑) → 手臂根部的凹陷窝 → 腋窝
phr: sweaty armpits 汗湿的腋窝
armpit odor 狐臭
armpit of the city 该市最脏乱破败之处

t: n. 上升；攀登；上坡路；晋升
en: The steep ascent left us gasping for air, but that view at the top? Totally worth the sweat.
cn: 爬这大陡坡差点没把我俩累断气，不过登顶后的这景色？流这身汗也值了。
tip: ascend(上升)的名词形式 → 向上攀登；晋升
phr: steep ascent 陡峭的上坡
rapid ascent to power 迅速掌权
make the ascent 登顶

t: n. 烟灰缸
en: Kissing him was like licking a wet ashtray; I immediately regretted the date.
cn: 跟他接吻简直像是在舔一个湿漉漉的烟灰缸，我当场就后悔出来约会了。
tip: ash(烟灰) + tray(托盘) → 接烟灰的盘子 → 烟灰缸
phr: empty the ashtray 清理烟灰缸
smell like an ashtray 浑身烟味

t: n. 沥青；柏油
en: It's so hot that my shoes are literally sticking to the melting asphalt.
cn: 天热得离谱，我的鞋底都粘在化了的柏油路上了，每走一步都费劲。
phr: asphalt road 柏油路
lay asphalt 铺设沥青
smell of fresh asphalt 新铺沥青的气味

t: adv. 确实地；无疑地；自信地
en: That was assuredly the worst presentation I have ever given in my entire career.
cn: 那绝对是我职业生涯里讲得最烂的一次，简直没眼看。
tip: assured(确定的) + ly → 确信无疑地 → 确实地，无疑地
phr: most assuredly 必定无疑地
speak assuredly 自信沉着地表态

t: n. 大使馆专员；随员；公文包
en: The cultural attaché awkwardly tried to explain the slang term to the ambassador, causing a few chuckles.
cn: 那位文化专员尴尬地试图向大使解释那个网络俚语，惹得大家忍俊不禁。

t: n. 视听教材；视听辅助教具；视听手段
en: The teacher struggled to set up the audiovisuals, and the class spent ten minutes staring at a blank screen.
cn: 老师折腾了半天那些视听设备，结果全班不得不盯着黑屏发了十分钟呆。

t: v. 唤醒；醒来；觉醒；激起
en: I am afraid the construction noise will awaken me before my alarm goes off.
cn: 怕是闹钟还没响，楼下装修那动静就得把我从梦里震醒。
tip: a + wake(醒) + en(使) → 唤醒；使觉醒
phr: awaken from a nightmare 从噩梦中醒来
awaken interest 激起兴趣
awaken to the reality 认识到现实

t: adv. 非常；极其；恶劣地；可怕地
en: I am awfully sorry for messing up your schedule like that.
cn: 把你的日程表搞得一团糟，我真的特别过意不去。
tip: awful(极度的) + ly → 口语中极力加强语气 → 非常，极其
phr: awfully sorry 极其抱歉
behave awfully 表现极其差劲

t: adv. 笨拙地；尴尬地；不合适地
en: We stood there awkwardly in the elevator, pretending to look at our phones to avoid eye contact.
cn: 我们尴尬地站在电梯里，假装看手机来避开眼神接触。
tip: awkward(尴尬的) + ly(副词后缀) → 笨拙地；尴尬地
phr: smile awkwardly 尴尬地微笑
land awkwardly 落地姿势别扭
awkwardly positioned 位置不妥

t: n. 公理；格言；自明之理
en: It is a business axiom that the customer is always right, even when they are wrong.
cn: 顾客就是上帝，这在生意场上是条铁律，哪怕他们错了你也得认。
tip: 形似 axis(轴心) → 思想体系的轴心立足点 → 自明之理；公理
phr: accept as an axiom 奉为公理
mathematical axiom 数学公理

t: v. 临时照看（婴儿）；当临时保姆
en: I promised to baby-sit my sister's kids, not realizing they are basically tiny monsters.
cn: 我答应帮姐姐看娃，结果完全没想到这两个小家伙简直就是破坏力惊人的小怪兽。

t: adj. 松垮的；袋状的；宽松的
en: He wears those baggy jeans that look like they're about to fall off.
cn: 他穿着那条松松垮垮的牛仔裤，看着像是随时都要掉下来，真不懂这时尚。
tip: bag(袋子) + y → 像大布袋一样松垂的 → 松垮的；宽松的
phr: baggy trousers 宽松阔腿裤
baggy eyes 浮肿下垂的眼袋

t: n. 面包师；烘焙师
en: The baker gave me an extra donut because I looked really sad this morning.
cn: 那个面包师看我一脸丧气，特意多送了我一个甜甜圈哄我开心。

t: n. 大捆；大包（干草、棉花等）；v. 把…打包成捆
en: We sat on a bale of hay watching the stars, getting itchy but feeling romantic.
cn: 我们坐在干草垛上看星星，虽然身上痒得要命，但感觉还挺浪漫的。
phr: bale of hay 一大捆干草
bale up cotton 将棉花打包成捆

t: n. 圆珠笔
en: My ball-point pen leaked in my pocket, ruining my white shirt with blue ink.
cn: 我兜里那支圆珠笔漏油了，把你那件白衬衫染得黑一块蓝一块的。

t: n. 土匪；强盗；歹徒
en: The toddler looked like a little bandit with chocolate smeared all over his face.
cn: 这孩子弄得满脸都是巧克力，看着就像个刚偷吃完的小土匪。
tip: ban(通缉/放逐) + dit → 被通缉流放的恶徒 → 土匪，强盗
phr: armed bandits 武装土匪
one-armed bandit 老虎机

t: n. （楼梯的）栏杆；扶手
en: I used to slide down the banister when I was a kid until I fell off and broke my arm.
cn: 小时候我老爱顺着楼梯扶手往下滑，直到有次摔下来折了胳膊才老实。
phr: hold the banister 扶住楼梯扶手
slide down the banister 顺着栏杆滑下

t: n. 洗礼；严峻考验
en: My first week at the new job was a real baptism of fire.
cn: 新工作第一周就像经历了场火的洗礼，差点没把我折腾死。
tip: bapt(baptize洗礼) + ism → 入水受洗仪式 → 洗礼；考验
phr: baptism of fire 战火的洗礼
infant baptism 婴儿洗礼

t: v. 给……施洗礼；洗礼；命名
en: I accidentally baptized my new laptop with a cup of coffee this morning.
cn: 今早我不小心把一杯咖啡全泼在新电脑上了，给它来了个“洗礼”。
tip: bapt(浸入) + ize → 浸入圣水中洗涤罪恶 → 给……施洗礼
phr: baptize a child 为婴儿施洗
be baptized into 加入（某教会）

t: n. 野蛮人；没文化的人；adj. 野蛮的
en: Who eats pizza with a spoon? You are an absolute barbarian.
cn: 谁吃披萨还用勺子啊？你简直就是个未开化的野人。
tip: barbar(异族吧啦声) + ian(人) → 听不懂话的蛮邦人 → 野蛮人
phr: barbarian invasion 蛮族入侵
behave like a barbarian 举止粗鄙野蛮

t: adj. 野蛮的；残暴的；粗俗的
en: It is absolutely barbarous to wake someone up at 5 AM on a Saturday.
cn: 周六大清早五点就把人叫醒，这简直就是丧尽天良的野蛮行径。

t: n. 大麦
en: A hot cup of barley tea is perfect after a heavy meal.
cn: 吃完油腻的大餐，喝上一杯热乎的大麦茶，胃里瞬间舒服多了。
tip: bar(酒吧) + ley → 啤酒吧里酿酒的核心谷物 → 大麦
phr: pearl barley 精制大麦仁
barley field 大麦田

t: n. 气压计；晴雨表（barometer 的变体拼写）
en: The barometre is falling rapidly, which usually means a heavy storm is approaching.
cn: 气压计读数正在急剧下降，这通常意味着暴风雨马上就要来了。

t: n. 基础；基本原理；基本设施
en: You need to master the basics before you try any fancy tricks.
cn: 你想玩花活儿之前，得先把基本功练扎实了。
tip: basic(基础的) + s → 基础要素 → 基础；基本原理
phr: back to basics 回归基础
master the basics 掌握基本功
bare basics 最基本要素

t: n. 混蛋；私生子；讨厌鬼
en: I can't believe that bastard cheated on her after everything she did for him.
cn: 那混蛋居然背着她偷吃，真不明白她对他那么好图啥。
phr: lucky bastard 幸运儿
poor bastard 可怜的倒霉蛋

t: n. 战场；沙场；争斗场所
en: The kitchen looked like a battlefield after he tried to cook a simple spaghetti dinner.
cn: 他不过就是煮个意大利面，结果把厨房搞得像刚打完仗的战场一样乱。
tip: battle(战斗) + field(场地) → 战场
phr: fall on the battlefield 阵亡沙场
political battlefield 政治角斗场
battlefield hospital 战地医院

t: n. 灯塔；指路明灯；烽火；无线电信标
en: That 24-hour convenience store was a beacon of hope in my drunken hunger.
cn: 在我醉得半死又饿得发慌时，那家24小时便利店简直就是救命稻草。
phr: beacon of hope 希望的灯塔
radio beacon 无线电信标

t: n. 烧杯；大口杯
en: I knocked over a beaker of acid in chem lab and burned a hole right through my shoe.
cn: 化学课上我打翻了一个装酸的烧杯，直接把鞋烧了个洞。
tip: beak(鸟嘴/倒水口) + er → 带倒水口的器皿 → 烧杯
phr: glass beaker 玻璃烧杯
pour into a beaker 倒入烧杯中

t: n. 豆芽
en: I hate the texture of the bean-sprout in my noodles, it's too crunchy.
cn: 我特讨厌面条里放豆芽，嚼起来那股脆劲儿让我很难受。

t: n. 就寝时间
en: It's way past my bedtime, but I can't stop scrolling through these videos.
